context.zh-TW: Aminoguanidine 是首個被引入作為 AGE inhibitor 的 agent。它與 pyridoxamine 等相關 inhibitors 透過與 highly reactive carbonyl species 交互作用並作為 carbonyl traps，來防止 AGE accumulation。Aminoguanidine 在 animal models 中透過抑制 AGE formation，預防了 diabetic renal、retinal 與 neural complications。然而，由於包括 pro-oxidant activities 與抑制 nitric oxide synthase 在內的 safety concerns，它無法臨床使用，因此其角色現主要作為 research tool 與 reference compound。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: Aminoguanidine

context.en-US: Aminoguanidine is an AGE inhibitor that acts as a carbonyl trap, interacting with highly reactive carbonyl species and preventing them from reacting with proteins. These reactive carbonyls include dicarbonyls such as methylglyoxal, glyoxal, and 3-deoxyglucosone, which are key intermediates in AGE formation. By trapping these dicarbonyl species, aminoguanidine blocks AGE accumulation and the downstream glycation damage. This mechanism is shared with other AGE inhibitors such as pyridoxamine, and underpins aminoguanidine's ability to prevent diabetic complications in animal models.
context.zh-TW: Aminoguanidine 是一種 AGE inhibitor，作為 carbonyl trap，與 highly reactive carbonyl species 交互作用並防止其與蛋白質反應。這些 reactive carbonyls 包括 methylglyoxal、glyoxal 與 3-deoxyglucosone 等 dicarbonyls，它們是 AGE formation 的關鍵 intermediates。透過 trapping 這些 dicarbonyl species，aminoguanidine 阻斷 AGE accumulation 與 downstream glycation damage。此 mechanism 與 pyridoxamine 等其他 AGE inhibitors 共享，並構成 aminoguanidine 在 animal models 中預防 diabetic complications 能力的基礎。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: Pyridoxamine

context.en-US: Pyridoxamine is a synthetic AGE inhibitor that prevents AGE accumulation by interacting with highly reactive carbonyl species and acting as a carbonyl trap, similar to aminoguanidine. By scavenging carbonyl intermediates, pyridoxamine blocks the formation of advanced glycation end products and is considered a candidate for preventing glycation-mediated pathology. Unlike aminoguanidine, pyridoxamine (a vitamin B6 derivative) has a more favorable safety profile. AGE inhibitors and carbonyl-trapping agents remain an active area of research for reducing AGE burden in diabetes and aging.
context.zh-TW: Pyridoxamine 是一種 synthetic AGE inhibitor，透過與 highly reactive carbonyl species 交互作用並作為 carbonyl trap 來防止 AGE accumulation，類似於 aminoguanidine。透過 scavenging carbonyl intermediates，pyridoxamine 阻斷 advanced glycation end products 的形成，並被視為預防 glycation-mediated pathology 的 candidate。不同於 aminoguanidine，pyridoxamine（一種 vitamin B6 derivative）具有更有利的 safety profile。AGE inhibitors 與 carbonyl-trapping agents 仍是減少 diabetes 與 aging 中 AGE burden 的活躍研究領域。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: Aminoguanidine

context.en-US: Aminoguanidine was the first AGE inhibitor and has been shown in previous reports to prevent diabetic renal, retinal, and neural complications through the inhibition of AGE formation. It was also shown to prevent diabetes-induced arterial wall protein cross-linking. However, aminoguanidine cannot be used clinically due to safety concerns including pro-oxidant activities and inhibition of nitric oxide synthase. Its efficacy in animal models established the concept that blocking glycation can prevent diabetic complications and validated AGEs as a therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: Aminoguanidine 是首個 AGE inhibitor，先前報告已證實其透過抑制 AGE formation 來預防 diabetic renal、retinal 與 neural complications。它也被證實能預防 diabetes-induced arterial wall protein cross-linking。然而，由於包括 pro-oxidant activities 與抑制 nitric oxide synthase 在內的 safety concerns，aminoguanidine 無法臨床使用。其在 animal models 中的 efficacy 確立了 blocking glycation 可預防 diabetic complications 的概念，並 validated AGEs 作為 therapeutic target。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: Aminoguanidine

context.en-US: Aminoguanidine, the first AGE inhibitor, has a safety concern related to its inhibition of nitric oxide synthase. By blocking NOS, aminoguanidine can reduce nitric oxide production, which together with its pro-oxidant activities prevented its clinical use. This NOS inhibition is one of the adverse effects that emerged during evaluation of aminoguanidine as a therapeutic agent. Despite these limitations, aminoguanidine remains a key research compound that established the concept of AGE inhibition for preventing diabetic complications.
context.zh-TW: Aminoguanidine 作為首個 AGE inhibitor，其 safety concern 與抑制 nitric oxide synthase（NOS）有關。透過 blocking NOS，aminoguanidine 可減少 nitric oxide production，這與其 pro-oxidant activities 一起阻止了其 clinical use。此 NOS inhibition 是在評估 aminoguanidine 作為 therapeutic agent 期間出現的 adverse effects 之一。儘管有這些 limitations，aminoguanidine 仍是確立 AGE inhibition 以預防 diabetic complications 概念的關鍵 research compound。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: Alagebrium

context.en-US: Alagebrium is an AGE breaker developed to destroy preformed AGE-derived protein cross-links, following the first AGE breaker N-phenacylthiazolium bromide, which was unstable in vitro and clinically unsuccessful. Alagebrium could reverse AGE accumulation in vivo, and AGE breakers of this class restored large artery properties in experimental diabetes. However, clinical studies on these compounds were terminated, and none of the known AGE breakers are currently in clinical use. AGE breakers represent a complementary therapeutic strategy to AGE inhibitors, targeting existing cross-links rather than preventing new AGE formation.
context.zh-TW: Alagebrium 是一種 AGE breaker，開發用於 destroy preformed AGE-derived protein cross-links，繼首個 AGE breaker N-phenacylthiazolium bromide 之後，後者在體外 unstable 且 clinically unsuccessful。Alagebrium 能在體內 reverse AGE accumulation，且此類 AGE breakers 在 experimental diabetes 中 restored large artery properties。然而，針對這些 compounds 的 clinical studies 已 terminated，且目前已知的所有 AGE breakers 均無 clinical use。AGE breakers 代表了與 AGE inhibitors 互補的 therapeutic strategy，針對 existing cross-links 而非 preventing new AGE formation。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: Epicatechin

context.en-US: Epicatechin, a flavanol, demonstrates potent AGE-breaking properties in vitro and in vivo. It destroyed preformed glycated serum albumin in vitro and decreased AGE accumulation in retinal tissues of rats injected with exogenous AGE. Mechanistically, side chains attached to the pyrrole ring carbons of AGE structures are susceptible to nucleophilic attack, and because C6 and C8 on the A-ring of epicatechin are nucleophilic, epicatechin can attack and destroy AGE cross-links. These findings position epicatechin as a naturally occurring AGE breaker with potential for preventing AGE-mediated tissue damage.
context.zh-TW: Epicatechin 是一種 flavanol，在體外與體內展現 potent AGE-breaking properties。它在體外 destroyed preformed glycated serum albumin，並降低了注射 exogenous AGE 的 rats retinal tissues 中的 AGE accumulation。在機制上，連接於 AGE structures pyrrole ring carbons 上的 side chains 易受 nucleophilic attack，而由於 epicatechin A-ring 上的 C6 與 C8 具有 nucleophilic，epicatechin 可 attack 並 destroy AGE cross-links。這些 findings 將 epicatechin 定位為一種 naturally occurring AGE breaker，具有預防 AGE-mediated tissue damage 的潛力。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: Epicatechin

context.en-US: Epicatechin is a flavanol with potent anti-glycation and AGE-breaking properties. In vitro it destroys preformed glycated serum albumin, and in vivo it decreased AGE accumulation in retinal tissues of rats injected with exogenous AGE. The nucleophilic C6 and C8 carbons of epicatechin's A-ring can attack the pyrrole ring carbons of AGE structures, breaking AGE cross-links. Epicatechin's dual capacity to inhibit glycation and break existing AGEs makes it a promising natural agent for reducing AGE burden, and its effects are similar to or stronger than those of aminoguanidine.
context.zh-TW: Epicatechin 是一種具有強效抗糖化與 AGE 裂解特性的黃烷醇。在體外，它能破壞已形成的糖化血清白蛋白；在體內，它降低了注射外源性 AGE 之大鼠視網膜組織中的 AGE 累積。Epicatechin 之 A 環具親核性的 C6 與 C8 碳原子可攻擊 AGE 結構的吡咯環碳原子，切斷 AGE 交聯。Epicatechin 同時抑制糖化並裂解既有 AGE 的雙重能力，使其成為降低 AGE 負擔的極具潛力天然物質，且其效果與 aminoguanidine 相似或更佳。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: Flavonoids

context.en-US: Flavonoids are the major class of polyphenols and possess anti-glycation properties. Anti-glycation activities of various flavonoids, such as kaempferol, genistein, quercitrin, and quercetin, have been reported, with potencies similar to or stronger than the reference AGE inhibitor aminoguanidine. These natural products with high antioxidant capacity inhibit protein glycation both in vitro and in vivo, and their anti-AGE activity may be one mechanism of their beneficial effects on human health. Herbal products rich in flavonoids are therefore investigated as safer alternatives to synthetic AGE inhibitors.
context.zh-TW: 類黃酮是多酚的主要類別，並具有抗糖化特性。各種類黃酮（如山奈酚、金雀異黃素、槲皮苷與槲皮素）的抗糖化活性已有文獻報導，其效力與參考用 AGE 抑制劑氨基胍相似或更強。這些具有高抗氧化能力的天然產物在體外與體內均能抑制蛋白質糖化，而其抗 AGE 活性可能是其對人體健康有益作用的機制之一。因此，富含類黃酮的草本產品被研究作為合成 AGE 抑制劑的更安全替代方案。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: Kaempferol

context.en-US: Kaempferol is a flavonoid polyphenol reported to possess anti-glycation properties. Along with other flavonoids such as genistein, quercitrin, and quercetin, kaempferol inhibits the glycation process in vitro, and several herbal polyphenols have anti-glycation activities similar to or stronger than aminoguanidine. These compounds act partly through their antioxidant capacity, which reduces the ROS-driven acceleration of protein glycation. Flavonoid-rich herbs and dietary plants are therefore considered promising, relatively safe agents for the prevention of glycation and AGE formation during aging.
context.zh-TW: Kaempferol 是一種類黃酮多酚，據報導具有抗糖化特性。與其他類黃酮如 genistein、quercitrin 和 quercetin 一樣，Kaempferol 在體外抑制糖化過程，且數種草本多酚具有與 aminoguanidine 相似或更強的抗糖化活性。這些化合物部分透過其抗氧化能力發揮作用，進而減少 ROS 驅動的蛋白質糖化加速。因此，富含類黃酮的草本植物與食用植物被視為在老化過程中預防糖化與 AGE 形成的具潛力且相對安全的物質。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: Quercetin

context.en-US: Quercetin is a flavonoid polyphenol with reported anti-glycation properties. Along with kaempferol, genistein, and quercitrin, quercetin inhibits the glycation process in vitro, and the anti-glycation activities of several polyphenols are similar to or even stronger than the reference inhibitor aminoguanidine. These flavonoids act partly through high antioxidant capacity, which counteracts the ROS that accelerate glycation. Because naturally occurring phytochemicals are relatively safe and available in oral forms, flavonoid-rich herbs are promising agents for the prevention of glycation and AGE formation.
context.zh-TW: Quercetin 是一種據報導具有抗糖化特性的類黃酮多酚。與 kaempferol、genistein 和 quercitrin 一起，quercetin 在體外抑制糖化過程，且數種多酚的抗糖化活性類似於或甚至強於參考抑制劑 aminoguanidine。這些類黃酮部分透過高抗氧化能力作用，抵消加速糖化的 ROS。由於天然存在的植物化學物質相對安全且可供口服形式，富含類黃酮的草藥是用於預防糖化與 AGE 形成的極具潛力物質。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: Genistein

context.en-US: Genistein is an isoflavone flavonoid reported to possess anti-glycation properties. Together with other flavonoids such as kaempferol, quercitrin, and quercetin, genistein inhibits the glycation process in vitro. The anti-glycation activities of these polyphenols are similar to or even stronger than aminoguanidine, and they act in part through trapping reactive carbonyl species and antioxidant capacity. Herbal products and dietary plants containing these flavonoids are therefore considered promising, relatively safe agents for preventing glycation and AGE accumulation during aging.
context.zh-TW: Genistein 是一種異黃酮類黃酮，據報導具有抗糖化特性。與其他黃酮類如 kaempferol、quercitrin 與 quercetin 一起，Genistein 在體外抑制糖化過程。這些多酚的抗糖化活性與 aminoguanidine 相似甚至更強，且部分透過捕捉活性羰基物種與抗氧化能力來作用。因此，含有這些黃酮類的草藥產品與食用植物被視為在老化過程中預防糖化與 AGE 堆積的具潛力且相對安全的物質。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: Exercise

context.en-US: Regular physical exercise has beneficial effects on glycemic control, and because AGE formation is accelerated by hyperglycemia, improved glycemic control attenuates the formation and accumulation of AGEs in tissues. Exercise benefits diabetic patients by improving glycemic control, and physical activity reduces AGE accumulation in diabetic patients and during aging. The higher energy demands of exercise may also reduce the pool of reactive intermediates available for glycation. Together with its antioxidant effects, glycemic control is a major mechanism by which exercise reduces AGE burden.
context.zh-TW: 規律的身體運動對血糖控制具有有益的效果，而由於高血糖會加速 AGE 的形成，改善血糖控制可減緩組織中 AGEs 的形成與堆積。運動透過改善血糖控制使糖尿病患者受益，且身體活動可減少糖尿病患者體內及老化過程中的 AGE 堆積。運動較高的能量需求也可能減少可用於糖化的反應性中間產物的庫存。結合其抗氧化作用，血糖控制是運動減輕 AGE 負擔的主要機制。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: Exercise

context.en-US: Moderate physical exercise induces the expression of antioxidant enzymes, leading to the reduction of oxidative stress. Exercise effectively inhibits ROS generation and improves the activities of antioxidant enzymes, and because the protein glycation reaction is driven and accelerated by ROS, the inhibition of AGE formation by regular exercise is attributed mainly to exercise-associated antioxidant activity. Physical exercise also decreases oxidative stress in rodent models and is reported to improve systemic antioxidant activity in humans. These antioxidant effects link exercise to reduced AGE accumulation and healthier aging.
context.zh-TW: 適度的身體運動會誘導抗氧化酵素的表現，進而降低氧化壓力。運動能有效抑制 ROS 的生成並提升抗氧化酵素的活性，而由於蛋白質糖化反應是由 ROS 驅動並加速的，規律運動對 AGE 形成的抑制主要歸因於運動相關的抗氧化活性。身體運動也能降低囓齒類動物模式中的氧化壓力，且據報導能改善人類的全身性抗氧化活性。這些抗氧化效應將運動與減少的 AGE 堆積及更健康的老化連結起來。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: Exercise

context.en-US: Regular physical exercise effectively inhibits reactive oxygen species generation and improves the activities of antioxidant enzymes. Because the protein glycation reaction is driven and accelerated by ROS, the inhibition of AGE formation by regular exercise is considered the main mechanism of exercise-associated antioxidant activity. Exercise also reduces oxidative stress in rodent models and improves glycemic control, both of which limit AGE accumulation. These effects make physical exercise a non-pharmacological strategy for attenuating glycation stress during aging.
context.zh-TW: 規律的身體運動能有效抑制活性氧（ROS）的生成，並提升抗氧化酵素的活性。由於蛋白質糖化反應受 ROS 驅動並加速，因此規律運動抑制 AGE 形成被視為運動相關抗氧化活性的主要機制。運動亦能降低囓齒類動物模型的氧化壓力並改善血糖控制，兩者皆能限制 AGE 累積。這些效應使身體運動成為減緩老化過程中糖化壓力的非藥物策略。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: Hyperglycemia

context.en-US: High glucose conditions shorten lifespan and increase AGE content in Caenorhabditis elegans: worms grown under 40 mM glucose had a shortened lifespan and increased advanced glycation end product content. This finding links hyperglycemia directly to reduced lifespan through AGE accumulation, consistent with the theory that abnormal accumulation of biological waste products promotes aging. It also supports the broader conclusion that AGE formation and accumulation in tissues can influence lifespan, and that inhibiting AGE formation may prolong it.
context.zh-TW: 高葡萄糖條件會縮短線蟲 Caenorhabditis elegans 的壽命並增加 AGE 含量：在 40 mM glucose 下生長的線蟲壽命縮短，且晚期糖化終產物含量增加。此發現透過 AGE 的累積將高血糖直接與壽命縮短連結起來，與「生物廢物異常累積會促進老化」的理論一致。這也支持更廣泛的結論：組織中 AGE 的形成與累積會影響壽命，而抑制 AGE 形成可能延長壽命。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: AGE inhibition

context.en-US: The inhibition of AGE formation and accumulation in tissues can lead to an increase in lifespan, as concluded from extensive evidence that AGE accumulation accompanies aging and age-related diseases. Because there are no enzymes to remove glycated products, AGEs accumulate as metabolic waste and contribute to tissue senescence. Inhibiting the glycation process and removing existing glycation products may prolong lifespan, and dietary herbal supplements or physiological exercise are advantageous in reducing the AGE burden in the body.
context.zh-TW: 抑制組織中 AGE 的形成與堆積可導致壽命延長，此結論源自大量證據顯示 AGE 堆積伴隨老化與老化相關疾病。由於體內缺乏可移除糖化產物的酵素，AGEs 便作為代謝廢物堆積並促進組織衰老。抑制糖化過程並清除既有的糖化產物或可延長壽命，而飲食草本補充劑或生理性運動則有利於減輕體內的 AGE 負擔。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: AGE-restricted diet

context.en-US: A diet restricting advanced glycation end products can effectively reduce the AGE burden in the human body. In renal failure patients, a low-AGE diet produced a 34% reduction in blood CML levels, while an AGE-rich diet increased CML by 29%. Because significant AGE generation occurs when sugars are cooked with proteins, dietary intake is an important exogenous source of glycotoxins. Restricting dietary AGEs is therefore proposed as an effective way to reduce circulating AGE levels and protect against AGE-related organ dysfunction and tissue aging.
context.zh-TW: 限制晚期糖化終產物（advanced glycation end products，AGE）的飲食能有效降低人體內的 AGE 負擔。在腎衰竭患者中，低 AGE 飲食使血液 CML 濃度下降 34%，而富含 AGE 的飲食則使 CML 上升 29%。由於糖類與蛋白質共同烹煮時會產生大量 AGE，飲食攝取是 glycotoxins 的重要外源性來源。因此，限制飲食中的 AGE 被視為降低循環 AGE 濃度、防護 AGE 相關器官功能障礙與組織老化的有效方式。

source_document: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is a pyridine nucleotide consisting of a nicotinamide riboside molecule bound to a phosphate group. It is an intermediate of the NAD+ salvage pathway and, when administered orally or intraperitoneally, is rapidly converted into NAD+ in major metabolic tissues such as the liver and skeletal muscle. In healthy subjects, oral NMN at 250 mg/day for 12 weeks elevated NAD+ levels in whole blood, and a 300 mg dose for 60 days raised serum NAD+/NADH levels by about 38%. In mice, oral NMN was absorbed from the intestine within minutes and produced a consistent increase in hepatic NAD+ at 15 to 30 minutes, showing that NMN acts as a direct biosynthetic precursor that replenishes the cellular NAD+ pool.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）是一種吡啶核苷酸，由一個菸鹼醯胺核糖分子與一個磷酸基團結合而成。它是 NAD+ 補救途徑的中間產物，當以口服或腹腔注射方式給藥時，會在肝臟和骨骼肌等主要代謝組織中迅速轉化為 NAD+。在健康受試者中，每日口服 250 mg NMN 持續 12 週可提升全血中的 NAD+ 水平，而 300 mg 劑量持續 60 天則使血清 NAD+/NADH 水平上升約 38%。在小鼠中，口服 NMN 於數分鐘內即從腸道吸收，並在 15 至 30 分鐘時造成肝臟 NAD+ 持續上升，顯示 NMN 作為一種直接生物合成前體，能補充細胞內的 NAD+ 庫。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) is a pyridine nucleoside made of a nicotinamide base attached to a ribose via a beta-N-glycosidic bond, and it functions as a vitamin-like NAD+ precursor known as the third NAD+ vitamin alongside nicotinamide and nicotinic acid. Oral NR robustly elevates NAD+ concentrations, raising blood NAD+ more than twofold (47.75 uM versus 20.90 uM placebo) and boosting NAAD by 4.5-fold and NMN by 1.4-fold without increasing nicotinamide in blood. NR can enter the salvage pathway directly after absorption or be hydrolyzed to nicotinamide by the glycohydrolase CD157 and routed through the Preiss-Handler pathway, and its metabolic effects are largely mediated by replenishing NAD+ to support sirtuin activity.
context.zh-TW: 煙醯胺核糖（NR）是一種吡啶核苷，由煙醯胺鹼基透過 β-N-糖苷鍵連接至核糖所構成，其作為一種類維生素的 NAD+ 前體，與煙醯胺及菸鹼酸並稱為第三種 NAD+ 維生素。口服 NR 能顯著提升 NAD+ 濃度，使血液中 NAD+ 升高超過兩倍（47.75 uM 對安慰劑組 20.90 uM），並使 NAAD 增加 4.5 倍、NMN 增加 1.4 倍，且不會提高血液中的煙醯胺。NR 在吸收後可直接進入補救途徑，或經糖水解酶 CD157 水解為煙醯胺，再透過 Preiss-Handler 途徑代謝，其代謝效應主要藉由補充 NAD+ 以支持 sirtuin 活性來介導。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: CD38

context.en-US: CD38 is an ectoenzyme that consumes NAD+ as a substrate and was found to also degrade nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN). Its levels and activity increase with aging, and this age-related upregulation is required for the NAD+ decline and mitochondrial dysfunction seen in old tissues. Because CD38 breaks down NMN, it alters the pharmacokinetics and bioavailability of both NMN and NR precursors. Consequently CD38 regulates the levels of NAD+, NMN, and SIRT1 activity, making it a candidate molecule for controlling neurodegeneration; in mice, CD38 knockdown suppressed axon degeneration, demyelination, and immune cell infiltration after facial nerve axotomy, and NR injection mimicked this protective effect.
context.zh-TW: CD38 是一種胞外酶，以 NAD+ 作為受質，且被發現也能降解菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）。其表現量與活性隨老化而增加，而這種與年齡相關的上調是老化組織中 NAD+ 下降與粒線體功能障礙所必需的。由於 CD38 會分解 NMN，它改變了 NMN 與 NR 前驅物的藥物動力學與生物可利用性。因此，CD38 調節 NAD+、NMN 與 SIRT1 活性的水平，使其成為控制神經退化的候選分子；在小鼠中，CD38 敲低抑制了面神經軸突切斷後的軸突退化、去髓鞘化與免疫細胞浸潤，而 NR 注射模擬了此保護作用。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: CD73

context.en-US: CD73 is an ecto-5'-nucleotidase that sustains NAD+ synthesis by processing extracellular nucleotide precursors. It dephosphorylates nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) into nicotinamide riboside (NR), which can then be taken up by cells, and it also degrades NAD+ into nicotinamide. In cell studies where NAMPT was inhibited, CD73 activity allowed cell viability by maintaining NAD+ synthesis through this extracellular conversion of NMN to NR. This CD73-mediated dephosphorylation is considered a route by which NMN becomes bioavailable for cellular uptake and salvage into NAD+, complementing the direct transporter pathway and highlighting the importance of ecto-enzymes in precursor metabolism.
context.zh-TW: CD73 是一種 ecto-5'-nucleotidase，透過處理細胞外核苷酸前驅物來維持 NAD+ 合成。它將 nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) 去磷酸化為 nicotinamide riboside (NR)，後者隨後可被細胞攝取，且它也將 NAD+ 降解為 nicotinamide。在 NAMPT 被抑制的細胞研究中，CD73 的活性透過此種將 NMN 轉化為 NR 的細胞外轉換來維持 NAD+ 合成，從而維持細胞存活。這種由 CD73 介導的去磷酸化被視為一條使 NMN 得以生物可利用、供細胞攝取並回收進入 NAD+ 的途徑，補足了直接的轉運蛋白途徑，並凸顯了胞外酶在前驅物代謝中的重要性。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: CD157

context.en-US: CD157, also called bone marrow stromal cell antigen 1 (BST1), is a glycohydrolase that participates in NAD+ precursor metabolism. It hydrolyzes nicotinamide riboside (NR) into nicotinamide (NAM), which is then further metabolized by gut microbiota into nicotinic acid and routed through the Preiss-Handler pathway to NAD+. In addition, CD157 displays base-exchange activity against both NR and niacin riboside (NAR), interconverting amidated and deamidated precursor pathways. This dual activity means CD157 not only diverts NR toward the deamidated route but also links the two branches of NAD+ biosynthesis, providing alternative substrates that maintain intracellular NAD+ levels depending on tissue and dietary context.
context.zh-TW: CD157，又稱骨髓基質細胞抗原1（BST1），是一種參與NAD+前體代謝的糖水解酶。它將菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）水解為菸鹼醯胺（NAM），隨後由腸道微生物群進一步代謝為菸鹼酸，並經由Preiss-Handler途徑進入NAD+。此外，CD157對NR與菸鹼酸核糖苷（NAR）均展現鹼基交換活性，使醯胺化與去醯胺化的前體途徑相互轉換。這種雙重活性意味著CD157不僅將NR導向去醯胺化路線，也連結NAD+生合成的兩個分支，提供替代受質，依組織與飲食背景維持細胞內NAD+水平。

subject: Gut Microbiome

context.en-US: The gut microbiome participates in host NAD+ metabolism because intestinal bacteria possess enzymes that convert nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) into nicotinic acid mononucleotide (NAMN) through deamidation, after which NAMN proceeds through the Preiss-Handler pathway toward NAD+ synthesis. Isotope-labeled NMN given orally to rats was partially deamidated by the intestinal microbiota before absorption, and nicotinic acid adenine dinucleotide levels rose in the liver, as also seen after NR supplementation. Shats and colleagues reported that NAD+ enhancement by nicotinamide and NR occurred mostly through this microbiota-dependent deamidated pathway, establishing gut bacteria as active metabolic partners that boost mammalian host NAD+ metabolism rather than simple bystanders.
context.zh-TW: 腸道微生物群參與宿主的 NAD+ 代謝，因為腸道細菌擁有能透過去醯胺化將菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）轉化為菸鹼酸單核苷酸（NAMN）的酵素，隨後 NAMN 經由 Preiss-Handler 途徑進行 NAD+ 合成。以同位素標記的 NMN 經口給予大鼠後，在吸收前被腸道微生物群部分去醯胺化，且菸鹼酸腺嘌呤二核苷酸在肝臟中的濃度上升，此現象在 NR 補充後亦被觀察到。Shats 及其同事報告指出，菸鹼醯胺與 NR 所帶來的 NAD+ 提升主要透過此一依賴微生物群的去醯胺化途徑發生，確立腸道細菌為能促進哺乳動物宿主 NAD+ 代謝的活躍代謝夥伴，而非單純的旁觀者。

subject: NAD+ Salvage Pathway

context.en-US: The NAD+ salvage pathway is the main recycling system for the oxidized coenzyme, and its principal substrates are the amidated precursors nicotinamide (NAM), nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), and nicotinamide riboside (NR). NR taken up directly from the diet enters cells and is phosphorylated to NMN and adenylated back into NAD+, restoring intracellular levels that fall with aging, overnutrition, and disease. The reduced forms dihydronicotinamide riboside (NRH) and dihydronicotinamide mononucleotide (NMNH) have also been shown to promote synthesis. Together with the de novo route from tryptophan and the Preiss-Handler pathway from nicotinic acid, this redundancy lets multiple dietary precursors maintain NAD+ homeostasis across tissues.
context.zh-TW: NAD+ 補救途徑是氧化輔酶的主要回收系統，其主要受質為醯胺化前驅物菸鹼醯胺（NAM）、菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）與菸鹼醯胺核苷（NR）。直接從飲食攝取的 NR 進入細胞後，被磷酸化為 NMN 並腺苷酸化回 NAD+，恢復隨老化、營養過剩與疾病而下降的細胞內濃度。還原型式的二氫菸鹼醯胺核苷（NRH）與二氫菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMNH）亦已被證實可促進合成。加上來自色胺酸的新生途徑與來自菸鹼酸的 Preiss-Handler 途徑，這種冗餘性使多種飲食前驅物得以在組織間維持 NAD+ 恆定。

subject: Sirtuins

context.en-US: Sirtuins (SIRT1-7) are NAD+-dependent enzymes that use NAD+ as a substrate to catalyze protein deacetylation or mono-ADP-ribosylation, coupling cellular energy status to gene expression and metabolism. The beneficial effects of NMN and NR supplementation are largely attributed to raising NAD+ levels, which enables sirtuin activity and downstream targets such as PGC-1alpha, FOXO transcription factors, and mitochondrial genes. SIRT1, SIRT2, and SIRT3 suppress the activity of NF-kB and the NLRP3 inflammasome through multiple mechanisms, while SIRT6 attenuates NF-kB signaling via H3K9 deacetylation, linking NAD+ precursor intake to anti-inflammatory and longevity-related outcomes in aging, diabetes, and COVID-19 contexts.
context.zh-TW: Sirtuins（SIRT1-7）是依賴 NAD+ 的酵素，利用 NAD+ 作為受質來催化蛋白質去乙醯化或單一 ADP-核糖基化，將細胞能量狀態與基因表現及代謝相偶聯。NMN 與 NR 補充的有益效果主要歸因於提升 NAD+ 濃度，這使得 sirtuin 活性及下游標的如 PGC-1alpha、FOXO 轉錄因子與粒線體基因得以作用。SIRT1、SIRT2 與 SIRT3 透過多種機制抑制 NF-kB 與 NLRP3 發炎體的活性，而 SIRT6 則經由 H3K9 去乙醯化減弱 NF-kB 訊息傳遞，將 NAD+ 前驅物攝取與老化、糖尿病及 COVID-19 背景下的抗發炎及與長壽相關的結果相連結。

subject: PARP

context.en-US: Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerases (PARPs) are NAD+-consuming enzymes that transfer ADP-ribose units onto proteins and nucleic acids, playing critical roles in DNA repair and antiviral immunity. During aging, accumulated DNA damage activates PARPs, which depletes NAD+ and reduces SIRT1 activity. In SARS-CoV-2 infection, PARPs inhibit viral transcript translation through ADP-ribosylation, but viral macrodomain proteins hydrolyze these ADPR units, and the compensatory hyperactivation of PARPs consumes NAD+; restoring NAD+ may therefore support the antiviral functions of PARPs. PARPs also consume NAD+ during diabetes-associated DNA repair, contributing to the NAD+/NADH redox imbalance that drives diabetic complications.
context.zh-TW: 聚(ADP-核糖)聚合酶（PARPs）是消耗 NAD+ 的酵素，可將 ADP-ribose 單元轉移至蛋白質與核酸上，在 DNA 修復與抗病毒免疫中扮演關鍵角色。老化過程中，累積的 DNA 損傷會活化 PARPs，進而耗竭 NAD+ 並降低 SIRT1 活性。在 SARS-CoV-2 感染中，PARPs 透過 ADP-ribosylation 抑制病毒轉錄本的轉譯，但病毒的 macrodomain 蛋白會水解這些 ADPR 單元，而 PARPs 的代償性過度活化會消耗 NAD+；因此補充 NAD+ 可能有助於支持 PARPs 的抗病毒功能。PARPs 在糖尿病相關的 DNA 修復過程中也會消耗 NAD+，促成驅動糖尿病併發症的 NAD+/NADH 氧化還原失衡。

subject: SARM1

context.en-US: SARM1 is a NAD+-consuming enzyme, grouped with CD38 and CD157 as an NAD+ glycohydrolase that degrades the coenzyme in signaling and stress pathways. Alongside ADP-ribosyl transferases, poly-ADP polymerases, and sirtuins, SARM1 mediates essential NAD+-dependent processes such as DNA repair, apoptosis, cell survival, lifespan regulation, and metabolic adjustments. Its NAD+ consumption contributes to the constant synthesis-catabolism-recycling cycle that sustains NAD+ levels, and disturbances that shift this balance, such as aging or infection, can reduce NAD+ availability. Dietary precursors like NMN and NR counter this by replenishing the NAD+ pool consumed by these signaling enzymes.
context.zh-TW: SARM1 是一種消耗 NAD+ 的酵素，與 CD38 和 CD157 同屬 NAD+ 糖苷水解酶，在訊號傳導與壓力路徑中降解此輔酶。與 ADP-ribosyl transferases、poly-ADP polymerases 和 sirtuins 一起，SARM1 介導 DNA 修復、凋亡、細胞存活、壽命調控與代謝調整等必需的 NAD+ 依賴性過程。其 NAD+ 消耗作用有助於維持 NAD+ 濃度恆定的合成—分解—再循環週期，而老化或感染等使此平衡偏移的擾動，會降低 NAD+ 的可利用性。NMN 與 NR 等膳食前驅物透過補充這些訊號酵素所消耗的 NAD+ 庫存來對抗此現象。

subject: Aging

context.en-US: Aging is associated with a progressive decline in NAD+ levels in various tissues, driven mainly by reduced NAMPT-mediated biosynthesis and by increased activity of the NAD+-consuming ectoenzyme CD38. NAMPT protein and NAD+ levels fall significantly in organs such as white adipose tissue and skeletal muscle of old mice, which impairs the activity of NAD+-dependent enzymes like sirtuins and alters cellular redox balance, leading to functional decline. This age-related NAD+ depletion is a hallmark of physiological decline and is linked to the onset of age-associated diseases including metabolic disorders, neurodegeneration, and ocular conditions, making NAD+ precursors a proposed strategy to mitigate age-associated physiological decline.
context.zh-TW: 老化伴隨多種組織中 NAD+ 濃度的漸進性下降，主要由 NAMPT 介導的生物合成減少，以及消耗 NAD+ 的胞外酶 CD38 活性增加所驅動。在老年小鼠的白色脂肪組織與骨骼肌等器官中，NAMPT 蛋白與 NAD+ 濃度顯著下降，損害 sirtuins 等依賴 NAD+ 的酵素活性，並改變細胞氧化還原平衡，導致功能衰退。這種與年齡相關的 NAD+ 耗竭是生理衰退的特徵，且與代謝疾病、神經退化及眼部疾病等年齡相關疾病的發生有關，使 NAD+ 前驅物成為減緩年齡相關生理衰退的擬議策略。

subject: NAMPT

context.en-US: NAMPT (nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase) is the rate-limiting enzyme that converts nicotinamide into nicotinamide mononucleotide in the NAD+ salvage pathway. A significant cause of age-associated NAD+ decline is the decrease in NAMPT-mediated biosynthesis: NAMPT protein and NAD+ levels fall in white adipose tissue and skeletal muscle of old mice, reducing the activity of NAD+-dependent enzymes such as sirtuins. Inhibiting NAMPT decreases cell growth and increases susceptibility to oxidative stress, a concept being explored for cancer therapy, whereas NMN and NR bypass NAMPT to reverse the cell death it induces, underscoring NAMPT as the central control point of endogenous NAD+ production.
context.zh-TW: NAMPT（nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase，菸鹼醯胺磷酸核糖轉移酶）是 NAD+ 補救途徑中將菸鹼醯胺轉化為菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸的限速酶。年齡相關 NAD+ 下降的一個重要原因是 NAMPT 介導的生物合成減少：在老年小鼠的白色脂肪組織與骨骼肌中，NAMPT 蛋白與 NAD+ 濃度下降，降低了 sirtuins 等 NAD+ 依賴性酵素的活性。抑制 NAMPT 會減少細胞生長並增加對氧化壓力的敏感性，此概念正被探討用於癌症治療；而 NMN 與 NR 則繞過 NAMPT 以逆轉其所誘發的細胞死亡，凸顯 NAMPT 是內源性 NAD+ 生成的核心控制點。

subject: DNA Damage

context.en-US: During the aging process, DNA damage accumulates in the cell nucleus and activates PARPs, which consume NAD+ as a substrate for poly-ADP-ribosylation during DNA repair. This PARP activation depletes NAD+ levels and consequently reduces SIRT1 activity, contributing to age-related decline. In diabetes, overactivation of PARPs likewise diminishes NAD+ and exacerbates the NAD+/NADH redox imbalance that leads to oxidative stress and diabetic complications. Conversely, NMN treatment in telomere-dysfunction models dampened the DNA damage response and p53 activation, functionally rescuing liver fibrosis and improving mitochondrial biogenesis, showing that NAD+ precursor supplementation can offset the metabolic cost of DNA damage-driven PARP activity.
context.zh-TW: 在老化過程中，DNA 損傷在細胞核內累積並活化 PARPs，後者在 DNA 修復過程中消耗 NAD+ 作為聚 ADP-核糖基化的受質。此種 PARP 活化會耗竭 NAD+ 濃度，進而降低 SIRT1 活性，促成與年齡相關的衰退。在糖尿病中，PARPs 的過度活化同樣會減少 NAD+ 並加劇 NAD+/NADH 氧化還原失衡，導致氧化壓力與糖尿病併發症。相反地，在端粒功能障礙模型中，NMN 處理抑制了 DNA 損傷反應與 p53 活化，在功能上挽救肝纖維化並改善粒線體生成，顯示 NAD+ 前驅物補充可抵銷由 DNA 損傷驅動的 PARP 活性所帶來的代謝代價。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 is a NAD+-dependent deacetylase that, when activated by rising NAD+ levels, deacetylates and activates the transcriptional coactivator PGC-1alpha. PGC-1alpha in turn co-regulates mitochondrial genes and detoxifying enzymes that eliminate reactive oxygen species, increasing mitochondrial activity and biogenesis and leading to improved metabolism and antioxidant protection. This SIRT1-PGC1alpha axis links NAD+ precursor intake to mitochondrial health, and its targets include the FOXO1 and FOXO3a transcription factors. NR and NMN act through this pathway to improve mitochondrial function, enhance oxidative metabolism and energy expenditure, and protect tissues such as the myocardium against oxidative stress and apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 是一種 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶，當被上升的 NAD+ 濃度激活時，會去乙醯化並激活轉錄輔激活因子 PGC-1alpha。PGC-1alpha 進而共同調節粒線體基因與清除活性氧的解毒酶，提升粒線體活性與生物生成，並帶來改善的代謝與抗氧化保護。此 SIRT1-PGC1alpha 軸將 NAD+ 前驅物攝取與粒線體健康連結起來，其作用標的包括 FOXO1 與 FOXO3a 轉錄因子。NR 與 NMN 透過此路徑改善粒線體功能、增強氧化代謝與能量消耗，並保護如 myocardium 等組織免於氧化壓力與細胞凋亡。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: AMPK

context.en-US: AMPK is a cellular energy regulator that senses changes in the intracellular AMP/ATP ratio. Under energy limitation, low ATP levels activate AMPK, which switches on catabolic pathways that produce ATP by enhancing oxidative metabolism and mitochondrial biogenesis while switching off ATP-consuming anabolic pathways, thereby altering the NAD+/NADH ratio. By increasing cellular NAD+ levels, AMPK enhances SIRT1 activity, which then deacetylates and modulates energy metabolism-related targets including PGC-1alpha, FOXO1, and FOXO3a. This AMPK-SIRT1-NMNR circuit explains how nutrient and energy status couples to NAD+-dependent regulation, and why NAD+ precursor supplementation can reinforce these energy-sensing pathways.
context.zh-TW: AMPK 是一種細胞能量調節因子，可感知細胞內 AMP/ATP 比值的變化。在能量受限時，低 ATP 水平會活化 AMPK，進而開啟透過增強氧化代謝與粒線體生成來產生 ATP 的分解代謝路徑，同時關閉消耗 ATP 的合成代謝路徑，從而改變 NAD+/NADH 比值。透過提升細胞內 NAD+ 水平，AMPK 增強 SIRT1 活性，後者隨之去乙醯化並調節與能量代謝相關的標的，包括 PGC-1alpha、FOXO1 與 FOXO3a。此 AMPK-SIRT1-NMNR 迴路說明了營養與能量狀態如何與 NAD+ 依賴性調控相偶聯，以及為何 NAD+ 前驅物補充能強化這些能量感知路徑。

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) promoted telomere lengthening in aged mice, pre-aging mice, and humans. In one study, treating generation-4 mice with NMN in drinking water for 8 weeks lengthened telomeres, dampened the DNA damage response and p53 activation, functionally rescued liver fibrosis, and improved mitochondrial biogenesis and function in a partially SIRT1-dependent manner. The increased NAD+ levels in the liver of NMN-treated mice reversed hyperacetylation of several sirtuin targets, reinforcing sirtuin activity. These effects counteract the telomere shortening and sirtuin repression that accompany DNA damage accumulation, positioning NMN as a nutraceutical candidate to prevent age-related physiological decline.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）促進了老年小鼠、早衰小鼠與人類的端粒延長。在一項研究中，以飲用水添加 NMN 處理第4代小鼠 8 週，延長了端粒、抑制了 DNA 損傷反應與 p53 活化、在功能上挽救了肝纖維化，並以部分依賴 SIRT1 的方式改善了粒線體生成與功能。NMN 處理小鼠肝臟中升高的 NAD+ 濃度逆轉了數個 sirtuin 標的物的過度乙醯化，強化了 sirtuin 活性。這些效應抵消了伴隨 DNA 損傷累積而來的端粒縮短與 sirtuin 抑制，使 NMN 成為預防年齡相關生理衰退的營養補充劑候選物。
