subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is an effective intervention against the pathophysiology of type 2 diabetes in both diet-induced and age-induced mouse models. Intraperitoneal administration at 500 mg/kg body weight per day for 11 days substantially ameliorated impaired glucose tolerance and enhanced hepatic insulin sensitivity, with the reversal of gene expression changes related to oxidative stress, inflammatory response, and circadian rhythm partly resulting from SIRT1 activation. NMN also restored glucose-stimulated insulin secretion in aged beta-cell-specific SIRT1-overexpressing (BESTO) mice and aged wild-type mice, and in postmenopausal women with prediabetes, 250 mg/day for 10 weeks increased NAD+ in PBMCs and improved insulin signaling and sensitivity in skeletal muscle.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）是針對第2型糖尿病病理生理學的有效介入手段，適用於飲食誘發與年齡誘發的小鼠模型。以500 mg/kg體重每日腹腔注射、持續11天，可顯著改善受損的葡萄糖耐受性並增強肝臟胰島素敏感性；其對氧化壓力、發炎反應與晝夜節律相關基因表現變化的逆轉，部分源自SIRT1的活化。NMN亦能恢復老年β細胞專一性SIRT1過度表現（BESTO）小鼠與老年野生型小鼠，以及患有糖尿病前期的停經後婦女之葡萄糖刺激胰島素分泌；在後者中，每日250 mg、持續10週可提升PBMC中的NAD+，並改善骨骼肌的胰島素訊號傳遞與敏感性。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) improves insulin sensitivity and signaling, particularly in metabolically compromised settings. In postmenopausal women with overweight or obesity and prediabetes, oral NMN at 250 mg/day for 10 weeks increased NAD+ content in peripheral blood mononuclear cells and improved insulin signaling and sensitivity in skeletal muscle. In mouse models, NMN enhanced hepatic insulin sensitivity and ameliorated impaired glucose tolerance, although these benefits were most pronounced in the most metabolically compromised groups. Notably, NMN had no beneficial effect on glucose metabolism in healthy mice on a chow diet and even impaired glucose tolerance in lean-progenitor offspring, suggesting precursors act best when NAD+ levels are depleted.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）可改善胰島素敏感性與訊號傳遞，特別是在代謝受損的情況下。在患有超重或肥胖及糖尿病前期的停經後婦女中，每日口服 250 mg NMN 持續 10 週，增加了周邊血液單核細胞中的 NAD+ 含量，並改善了骨骼肌中的胰島素訊號傳遞與敏感性。在小鼠模型中，NMN 增強了肝臟胰島素敏感性並改善了受損的葡萄糖耐受性，儘管這些益處在代謝最受損的群體中最為顯著。值得注意的是，NMN 對飼料飲食下的健康小鼠之葡萄糖代謝並無有益影響，甚至在瘦型親代後代中損害了葡萄糖耐受性，這表明前驅物在 NAD+ 水平耗竭時效果最佳。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) restores insulin secretion that is impaired by inflammation and metabolic stress. In islets cultured with the pro-inflammatory cytokines IL-1beta and TNF-alpha, NMN administration at 100 umol/L restored insulin secretion in a partially SIRT1-dependent manner and corrected inflammation-induced islet dysfunction by reversing changes in genes encoding islet markers essential for glucose sensing and beta-cell differentiation. In mice fed a fructose-rich diet, NMN improved glucose-stimulated insulin secretion, indicating protection against beta-cell failure through an anti-inflammatory mechanism. This action supports NMN's anti-diabetic effects and its capacity to preserve pancreatic beta-cell function under cytokine-driven stress.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）可恢復因發炎與代謝壓力而受損的胰島素分泌。在以促發炎細胞激素 IL-1beta 與 TNF-alpha 培養的胰島中，100 umol/L 的 NMN 投予以部分依賴 SIRT1 的方式恢復了胰島素分泌，並透過逆轉編碼對葡萄糖感測與 beta-cell 分化不可或缺的胰島標記之基因變化，矯正了發炎誘發的胰島功能障礙。在餵食高果糖飲食的小鼠中，NMN 改善了葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌，顯示其透過抗發炎機制保護 beta-cell 免於衰竭。此作用支持了 NMN 的抗糖尿病效果，以及其在細胞激素驅動的壓力下維持胰臟 beta-cell 功能的能力。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) improves features of Alzheimer's disease by raising NAD+ levels and supporting sirtuin activity. It protects neuronal cells from oxidative stress, prevents beta-amyloid oligomer-induced cognitive impairment and neuronal death, and inhibits JNK activation to reverse Alzheimer's disease pathology in experimental models. NMN is proposed as a nutraceutical to prevent age-related physiological decline and has demonstrated cardio- and vasoprotective actions as well. Alongside nicotinamide riboside, which reduces neuroinflammation, phosphorylated Tau, DNA damage, and hippocampal neuron apoptosis while increasing neurogenesis, NMN represents a dietary NAD+ precursor strategy against neurodegenerative and age-related diseases.
context.zh-TW: Nicotinamide mononucleotide（NMN）透過提升 NAD+ 濃度並支持 sirtuin 活性，改善 Alzheimer's disease 的特徵。它能保護神經元細胞免受氧化壓力，防止 beta-amyloid 寡聚體誘發的認知障礙與神經元死亡，並抑制 JNK 活化以逆轉實驗模型中 Alzheimer's disease 的病理變化。NMN 被提議作為一種營養保健品，以預防與年齡相關的生理衰退，並且也已展現出心臟與血管保護作用。與 nicotinamide riboside 並用，後者能減少神經發炎、磷酸化 Tau、DNA 損傷與海馬神經元凋亡，同時增加神經生成，NMN 代表一種針對神經退化性與年齡相關疾病的飲食性 NAD+ 前驅物策略。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces beta-amyloid levels and protects cognitive function in Alzheimer's disease models. In Tg2576 mice, NR treatment lowered beta-amyloid and increased the chance of recognizing a novel object by 20%, indicating improved recognition memory. NR also significantly reduced neuroinflammation, apoptosis of hippocampal neurons, phosphorylated Tau, and DNA damage, while increasing neurogenesis by almost 20%. These cognitive and synaptic protective effects are attributed to NR's ability to elevate NAD+ and upregulate proliferator-activated receptor-gamma coactivator 1-alpha-regulated beta-secretase 1 degradation and mitochondrial gene expression, linking NAD+ precursor supplementation to preservation of learning, memory, and motor function.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）可降低 beta-amyloid 水平，並在阿茲海默症模型中保護認知功能。在 Tg2576 小鼠中，NR 處理降低了 beta-amyloid，並使辨識新物體的機率提高 20%，顯示辨識記憶改善。NR 也顯著減少神經發炎、海馬神經元凋亡、磷酸化 Tau 與 DNA 損傷，同時使神經生成增加近 20%。這些認知與突觸保護作用歸因於 NR 提升 NAD+ 並上調由 proliferator-activated receptor-gamma coactivator 1-alpha 調控的 beta-secretase 1 降解與粒線體基因表現的能力，將 NAD+ 前驅物補充與學習、記憶及運動功能的維持相連結。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) enhances neurogenesis while reducing neurodegenerative pathology in Alzheimer's disease models. NR treatment increased neurogenesis by almost 20% and simultaneously reduced neuroinflammation, apoptosis of hippocampal neurons, phosphorylated Tau, and DNA damage. These effects protect cognitive function, synaptic plasticity, learning, memory, and motor function in animal models. The mechanisms are attributed to NR raising NAD+ levels, which sustains sirtuin activity and mitochondrial gene expression, and reducing the beta-amyloid burden. This positions NR as a promising NAD+ precursor for counteracting the neuronal loss and cognitive decline associated with aging and Alzheimer's disease.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）在阿茲海默症模型中促進神經發生，同時減少神經退化性病理變化。NR 治療使神經發生增加近 20%，並同時減少神經發炎、海馬神經元凋亡、磷酸化 Tau 以及 DNA 損傷。這些效應在動物模型中保護認知功能、突觸可塑性、學習、記憶與運動功能。其機制歸因於 NR 提升 NAD+ 濃度，進而維持 sirtuin 活性與粒線體基因表現，並減少 beta-amyloid 負擔。這使 NR 成為一種具潛力的 NAD+ 前體，可用於對抗與老化及阿茲海默症相關的神經元喪失與認知衰退。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease models and in alcohol-induced depression models. In AD models, NR significantly reduced neuroinflammation, apoptosis of hippocampal neurons, phosphorylated Tau, and DNA damage while increasing neurogenesis. In mice with alcohol-induced depression, dietary NR for 10 weeks reduced both pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokine levels and inhibited microglial activation, with the protective effect attributed to NR upregulating brain-derived neurotrophic factor by altering gut microbiota composition. These findings connect NR's NAD+-boosting action to suppression of neuroinflammation, microglial reactivity, and preservation of cognitive and emotional function.
context.zh-TW: 煙醯胺核糖（NR）可降低Alzheimer's disease模型與酒精誘發憂鬱模型中的神經發炎。在AD模型中，NR顯著降低神經發炎、海馬神經元凋亡、磷酸化Tau與DNA損傷，同時增加神經生成。在酒精誘發憂鬱的小鼠中，飲食補充NR達10週降低了促發炎與抗發炎細胞激素濃度，並抑制小膠質細胞活化，其保護作用歸因於NR透過改變gut microbiota組成而上調brain-derived neurotrophic factor。這些發現將NR提升NAD+的作用與抑制神經發炎、小膠質細胞反應性，以及維持認知與情緒功能相連結。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) prevents and improves metabolic disorders such as high-fat diet-induced obesity. NR supplementation promoted metabolic flexibility by enhancing energy expenditure, significantly attenuating high-fat diet-induced body weight gain and decreasing fat mass, particularly in the liver where triglyceride levels dropped by 40%. NR also protected against hyperinsulinemia and elevated total and LDL cholesterol caused by a high-fat diet, while having no effect on body weight when given with a normal chow diet. Additionally, NR-conditioned gut microbiota conferred protection against high-fat diet weight gain through fecal transfer, linking the gut microbiome to its anti-obesity effects.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）可預防並改善代謝紊亂，例如高脂飲食誘發的肥胖。NR補充透過增強能量消耗來促進代謝靈活性，顯著減緩高脂飲食誘發的體重增加並降低脂肪量，尤其是在肝臟中，三酸甘油酯水平下降了40%。NR也保護免受高脂飲食引起的胰島素過高血症以及總膽固醇與LDL膽固醇升高，而在正常飼料飲食下給予時對體重無影響。此外，經NR調理的腸道微生物群透過糞便移植賦予對高脂飲食體重增加的保護力，將腸道微生物組與其抗肥胖效應連結起來。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) protects against non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and its metabolic sequelae by increasing NAD+ and stimulating sirtuins. NR supplementation increased hepatic beta-oxidation and mitochondrial content, reversing glucose intolerance, insulin resistance, liver lipid accumulation, and hepatic fibrosis in mouse models. In high-fat diet studies, NR reduced liver fat mass and decreased hepatic triglyceride levels by 40%. These benefits arise from NR elevating NAD+ in liver and muscle, which stimulates SIRT1 and SIRT3 activity to enhance oxidative metabolism and mitochondrial function, counteracting the fatty liver and metabolic inflexibility driven by overnutrition.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）透過提升 NAD+ 並刺激 sirtuins，保護免受非酒精性脂肪肝疾病（NAFLD）及其代謝後遺症之害。NR 補充增加了肝臟 β-氧化與粒線體含量，在小鼠模型中逆轉了葡萄糖耐受不良、胰島素抗性、肝臟脂質堆積與肝纖維化。在高脂飲食研究中，NR 減少了肝臟脂肪量，並使肝臟三酸甘油酯水平降低了 40%。這些益處源於 NR 提升肝臟與肌肉中的 NAD+，進而刺激 SIRT1 與 SIRT3 活性以增強氧化代謝與粒線體功能，抵銷由過度營養所驅動的脂肪肝與代謝不靈活。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) increases energy expenditure and promotes metabolic flexibility. By elevating NAD+ in liver and muscle, NR supplementation stimulated SIRT1 and SIRT3 activity, enhancing mitochondrial function, oxidative metabolism, and endurance performance in mice. NR's enhancement of energy expenditure significantly attenuated high-fat diet-induced body weight gain and decreased fat mass, particularly in the liver. NR also stabilized myocardial NAD+ levels, increasing glycolysis and citrate and acetyl-coenzyme A metabolism, which attenuated the development of heart failure in a dilated cardiomyopathy model. These metabolic effects establish NR as a dietary agent that supports energy homeostasis and protects against overnutrition-driven metabolic disease.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）增加能量消耗並促進代謝靈活性。透過提升肝臟與肌肉中的 NAD+，NR 補充刺激了 SIRT1 與 SIRT3 活性，增強粒線體功能、氧化代謝以及小鼠的耐力表現。NR 對能量消耗的增強顯著減緩了高脂飲食誘發的體重增加並降低脂肪量，尤其是在肝臟中。NR 也穩定了心肌 NAD+ 水平，增加糖解作用以及檸檬酸與乙醯輔酶 A 代謝，從而減緩了擴張型心肌病模型中心衰竭的發展。這些代謝效應確立了 NR 作為一種膳食性介入，能支持能量恆定並保護免受過度營養驅動的代謝疾病。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) activates SIRT3 by raising NAD+ levels. A 24-hour administration of NR to peripheral blood mononuclear cells from healthy subjects replicated the fasting effect of blunting NLRP3 inflammasome activation and enhancing mitochondrial quality control through SIRT3. NR reduced acetylation of SOD2 and isocitrate dehydrogenase 2, increasing mitochondrial SOD2 activity and thereby reducing mitochondrial reactive oxygen species levels. It also decreased secretion of IL-1beta and TNF-alpha in monocytes and macrophages. This SIRT3-dependent mechanism links NR intake to reduced mitochondrial oxidative stress and suppression of the NLRP3 inflammasome, underpinning its anti-inflammatory and metabolic benefits.
context.zh-TW: 煙醯胺核糖（NR）透過提升 NAD+ 濃度來活化 SIRT3。對健康受試者之周邊血單核球細胞給予 NR 達 24 小時，重現了禁食的效果，即透過 SIRT3 抑制 NLRP3 發炎體活化並增強粒線體品質控制。NR 降低了 SOD2 與異檸檬酸脫氫酶 2 的乙醯化，提升粒線體 SOD2 活性，從而降低粒線體活性氧物種濃度。它亦減少了單核球與巨噬細胞中 IL-1beta 與 TNF-alpha 的分泌。此一依賴 SIRT3 的機制將 NR 攝取與降低粒線體氧化壓力及抑制 NLRP3 發炎體相連結，奠定其抗發炎與代謝益處的基礎。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 is the primary mitochondrial NAD+-dependent deacetylase, and among its targets is SOD2 (manganese superoxide dismutase). When NR raises NAD+ and activates SIRT3, the acetylation of SOD2 is reduced, increasing mitochondrial SOD2 activity and thereby lowering mitochondrial reactive oxygen species. SIRT3 also deacetylates isocitrate dehydrogenase 2, enhancing mitochondrial antioxidant capacity and quality control. This SIRT3-SOD2 axis is central to NR's protective effects against oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, and NLRP3 inflammasome activation, and it also mediates the benefit of gut-microbiota-derived NMN in acute pancreatitis, where the SIRT3-PRDX5 pathway is engaged.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3 是主要的粒線體 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶，其標靶之一為 SOD2（錳超氧化物歧化酶）。當 NR 提升 NAD+ 並活化 SIRT3 時，SOD2 的乙醯化程度降低，進而增加粒線體 SOD2 活性，從而降低粒線體活性氧。SIRT3 也會去乙醯化 isocitrate dehydrogenase 2，增強粒線體抗氧化能力與品質控制。此 SIRT3-SOD2 軸線是 NR 對抗氧化壓力、粒線體功能障礙與 NLRP3 發炎體活化的保護作用之核心，並且也介導了腸道菌叢來源的 NMN 在急性胰腺炎中的益處，其中 SIRT3-PRDX5 路徑被啟動。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3, along with SIRT1 and SIRT2, suppresses the activity of NF-kB and the NLRP3 inflammasome through multiple mechanisms. Because sirtuins are NAD+-dependent, raising NAD+ with precursors such as NR enhances this suppression. In human peripheral blood mononuclear cells, 24-hour NR administration recapitulated the fasting effect of blunting NLRP3 inflammasome activation and enhancing mitochondrial quality control in a SIRT3-dependent manner, reducing secretion of IL-1beta and TNF-alpha. This sirtuin-mediated restraint of the NLRP3 inflammasome helps prevent cytokine storm in severe infections and mitigates the chronic inflammation associated with aging and metabolic disease.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3 與 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 一起，透過多種機制抑制 NF-kB 與 NLRP3 發炎體的活性。由於 sirtuins 依賴 NAD+，使用 NR 等前驅物提升 NAD+ 可增強此抑制作用。在人類周邊血單核細胞中，24 小時的 NR 投予重現了禁食效果，即透過 SIRT3 依賴的方式抑制 NLRP3 發炎體活化並增強粒線體品質控制，進而減少 IL-1beta 與 TNF-alpha 的分泌。這種由 sirtuin 介導的 NLRP3 發炎體抑制，有助於在嚴重感染中預防細胞激素風暴，並減緩與老化和代謝疾病相關的慢性發炎。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: SOD2

context.en-US: SOD2 (manganese superoxide dismutase) is the mitochondrial antioxidant enzyme that eliminates superoxide generated during respiration. Its activity is regulated by acetylation, with SIRT3-mediated deacetylation increasing SOD2 activity. When NR raises NAD+ and activates SIRT3, SOD2 acetylation decreases, mitochondrial SOD2 activity rises, and mitochondrial reactive oxygen species levels fall. This reduced mitochondrial ROS burden lessens oxidative damage and supports mitochondrial quality control, contributing to NR's protective effects against oxidative stress, inflammasome activation, and age-related mitochondrial dysfunction in tissues such as the myocardium, skeletal muscle, and neurons.
context.zh-TW: SOD2（錳超氧化物歧化酶）是在呼吸過程中消除所產生的超氧化物的粒線體抗氧化酶。其活性受乙醯化調控，其中 SIRT3 介導的去乙醯化會增加 SOD2 活性。當 NR 提升 NAD+ 並活化 SIRT3 時，SOD2 乙醯化下降，粒線體 SOD2 活性上升，粒線體活性氧物種水平降低。這種減少的粒線體 ROS 負擔減輕了氧化損傷並支持粒線體品質控制，有助於 NR 對氧化壓力、發炎體活化以及心肌、骨骼肌和神經元等組織中與年齡相關的粒線體功能障礙的保護作用。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) decreases secretion of the pro-inflammatory cytokine IL-1beta in human immune cells. In healthy volunteers, 24-hour NR administration reduced IL-1beta secretion in monocytes by over 50% (from approximately 22,000 to 10,000 pg/mL) and in macrophages by around 20% (from above 300 to less than 250 pg/mL). This effect is mediated by SIRT3-dependent blunting of NLRP3 inflammasome activation and enhanced mitochondrial quality control. By reducing IL-1beta and TNF-alpha production, NR demonstrates systemic anti-inflammatory activity consistent with its NAD+-boosting and sirtuin-activating mechanism.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）降低人類免疫細胞中促發炎細胞激素 IL-1beta 的分泌。在健康志願者中，24 小時 NR 給藥使單核細胞中 IL-1beta 分泌減少超過 50%（從約 22,000 降至 10,000 pg/mL），巨噬細胞中減少約 20%（從 300 以上降至 250 以下 pg/mL）。此效應由 SIRT3 依賴性的 NLRP3 發炎體活化減弱以及增強的粒線體品質控制所介導。透過減少 IL-1beta 和 TNF-alpha 的產生，NR 展現出與其提升 NAD+ 及活化去乙醯酶機制一致的全身性抗發炎活性。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces circulating and cellular levels of the pro-inflammatory cytokine TNF-alpha. In healthy volunteers, 24-hour NR administration decreased TNF-alpha secretion by over 75% in monocytes (from above 2000 to less than 500 pg/mL) and approximately 45% in macrophages (from around 1800 to 1000 pg/mL). In older men supplementing with 1 g of oral NR per day for 3 weeks, circulating TNF-alpha fell from around 250 to 200 pg/mL along with reductions in IL-2, IL-5, and IL-6. This anti-inflammatory action is mediated through NAD+-dependent sirtuin activation and contributes to NR's cardiovascular, metabolic, and neuroprotective benefits.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）降低促發炎細胞激素 TNF-alpha 的循環與細胞內水平。在健康志願者中，24 小時 NR 給藥使單核細胞中 TNF-alpha 分泌減少超過 75%（從 2000 以上降至 500 以下 pg/mL），巨噬細胞中減少約 45%（從約 1800 降至 1000 pg/mL）。在每天口服 1 g NR 持續 3 週的老年男性中，循環 TNF-alpha 從約 250 降至 200 pg/mL，同時 IL-2、IL-5 和 IL-6 也下降。此抗發炎作用透過 NAD+ 依賴性的去乙醯酶活化介導，並有助於 NR 的心血管、代謝和神經保護益處。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) suppresses inflammation and oxidative stress by downregulating cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2). In LPS-activated mouse and human macrophage cell lines (THP-1 and RAW264.7), treatment with 500 uM NMN decreased pro-inflammatory cytokine production and efficiently alleviated LPS-induced inflammation via the COX-2-PGE2 axis. NMN markedly decreased mRNA expression and extracellular secretion of IL-6 and IL-1beta and lowered cellular prostaglandin E2 levels, while proteins related to the inflammatory response such as RELL1, PTGS2, FGA, FGB, and igkv12-44 were reduced. NMN also suppressed prostanoid biosynthesis and NF-kB signaling, demonstrating broad anti-inflammatory activity in innate immune cells.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）透過下調環氧合酶-2（COX-2）抑制發炎與氧化壓力。在 LPS 活化的小鼠與人類巨噬細胞株（THP-1 和 RAW264.7）中，以 500 uM NMN 處理降低了促發炎細胞激素的產生，並透過 COX-2-PGE2 軸有效緩解 LPS 誘發的發炎。NMN 顯著降低 IL-6 和 IL-1beta 的 mRNA 表現與細胞外分泌，並降低細胞內前列腺素 E2 水平，而與發炎反應相關的蛋白如 RELL1、PTGS2、FGA、FGB 和 igkv12-44 則減少。NMN 也抑制類前列腺素生合成與 NF-kB 訊息傳導，展現先天免疫細胞中廣泛的抗發炎活性。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) suppresses NF-kB signaling as part of its anti-inflammatory mechanism. In LPS-activated macrophages, proteomics analysis identified that NMN downregulated COX-2 expression and suppressed inflammation-related pathways including prostanoid biosynthesis, LPS/IL-1-mediated inhibition of RXR function, and IL-6 and NF-kB signaling. This downregulation of NF-kB and related pathways decreased extracellular secretion of IL-6 and IL-1beta and lowered prostaglandin E2 levels, alleviating LPS-induced inflammation and oxidative stress. These effects complement the sirtuin-mediated suppression of NF-kB, positioning NMN as a dietary agent that restrains the master pro-inflammatory transcription factor.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）抑制 NF-kB 訊息傳導，作為其抗發炎機制的一部分。在 LPS 活化的巨噬細胞中，蛋白質體學分析發現 NMN 下調 COX-2 表現並抑制與發炎相關的路徑，包括類前列腺素生合成、LPS/IL-1 介導的 RXR 功能抑制，以及 IL-6 和 NF-kB 訊息傳導。此 NF-kB 及相關路徑的下調降低了 IL-6 和 IL-1beta 的細胞外分泌並降低前列腺素 E2 水平，緩解 LPS 誘發的發炎與氧化壓力。這些效應補充了去乙醯酶介導的 NF-kB 抑制，使 NMN 成為一種能抑制主要促發炎轉錄因子的膳食性物質。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) exerts cardio- and vasoprotective actions, protecting against heart failure, ischemia, and reperfusion injury. NMN preserves cardiac mitochondrial homeostasis, prevents heart failure in animal models, and attenuates cardiac fibrosis by regulating oxidative stress and Smad3 acetylation. It also restores angiogenic capacity and attenuates oxidative stress in aged cerebromicrovascular endothelial cells, and rescues endothelial dysfunction and neurovascular coupling in aged mice. By inhibiting inflammation and decreasing oxidative stress, NMN prevents arterial and endothelial dysfunction, supporting its proposed use as a nutraceutical against age-related cardiovascular decline.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）發揮心臟與血管保護作用，防護心衰竭、缺血與再灌流損傷。NMN 維持心臟粒線體恆定，在動物模型中預防心衰竭，並透過調節氧化壓力與 Smad3 乙醯化減緩心臟纖維化。它還恢復血管生成能力並減輕老化腦微血管內皮細胞中的氧化壓力，並挽救老化小鼠的內皮功能障礙與神經血管耦合。透過抑制發炎與降低氧化壓力，NMN 預防動脈與內皮功能障礙，支持其作為對抗與年齡相關心血管衰退的營養補充劑的用途。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) preserves cardiac function in heart failure models by stabilizing NAD+ levels. In a mouse model of dilated cardiomyopathy, NR at 450 mg/kg body weight for 45 days stabilized myocardial NAD+ levels, increased glycolysis, and citrate and acetyl-coenzyme A metabolism, attenuating the development of heart failure. NR also elevates myocardium NAD+ content in diabetic mice, promoting mitofusin 2-mediated mitochondrial fusion through the SIRT1-PGC1alpha-PPARalpha pathway, which suppresses oxidative stress and cell apoptosis. These cardiac benefits, combined with its reduction of inflammation and vascular protection, establish NR as a cardioprotective NAD+ precursor.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）透過穩定 NAD+ 水平在心力衰竭模型中維持心臟功能。在擴張型心肌病的小鼠模型中，以 450 mg/kg 體重 NR 給藥 45 天穩定了心肌 NAD+ 水平，增加糖解作用以及檸檬酸與乙醯輔酶 A 代謝，減緩心衰竭的發展。NR 也提升糖尿病小鼠心肌 NAD+ 含量，透過 SIRT1-PGC1alpha-PPARalpha 路徑促進 mitofusin 2 介導的粒線體融合，從而抑制氧化壓力與細胞凋亡。這些心臟益處，加上其減少發炎與血管保護作用，確立了 NR 作為具心臟保護作用的 NAD+ 前驅物。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) promotes mitochondrial fusion, particularly in the diabetic heart. Daily oral gavage of NR at 400 mg/kg/day for 4 weeks alleviated diabetes-induced cardiomyopathy and improved cardiac function in diabetic mice by elevating myocardium NAD+ content and promoting mitofusin 2-mediated mitochondrial fusion. This action occurs via the SIRT1-PGC1alpha-PPARalpha pathway and suppresses oxidative stress and cell apoptosis. By restoring balanced mitochondrial dynamics in a disease state characterized by mitochondrial fragmentation and dysfunction, NR supports cardiomyocyte survival and cardiac bioenergetics.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）促進粒線體融合，特別是在糖尿病心臟中。每天以 400 mg/kg/天 NR 口服灌胃 4 週，透過提升心肌 NAD+ 含量並促進 mitofusin 2 介導的粒線體融合，減輕糖尿病誘發的心肌病並改善糖尿病小鼠的心臟功能。此作用透過 SIRT1-PGC1alpha-PPARalpha 路徑發生，並抑制氧化壓力與細胞凋亡。透過在粒線體碎裂與功能障礙為特徵的疾病狀態中恢復平衡的粒線體動態，NR 支持心肌細胞存活與心臟生物能量學。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) derived from the gut microbiota ameliorates acute pancreatitis injury. In acute pancreatitis mouse models, NMN increased NAD+ levels and activated the SIRT3-PRDX5 pathway, mitigating pancreatic mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative damage, and inflammation in a partially SIRT3-dependent manner. Acute pancreatitis is exacerbated by gut microbiota dysbiosis, and normobiotic fecal microbiota transplantation induced higher serum NMN levels, enhancing NAD+ biosynthesis in the pancreas. This makes NMN an important mediator of the protective effects of fecal microbiota transplantation and highlights the role of gut microbiota-produced NAD+ precursors in pathological outcomes of the host.
context.zh-TW: 源自腸道菌叢的菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）改善急性胰臟炎損傷。在急性胰臟炎小鼠模型中，NMN 提升 NAD+ 水平並活化 SIRT3-PRDX5 路徑，以部分依賴 SIRT3 的方式減輕胰臟粒線體功能障礙、氧化損傷與發炎。急性胰臟炎會因腸道菌叢失調而惡化，而正常菌叢糞便微生物移植誘導了較高的血清 NMN 水平，增強胰臟中的 NAD+ 生合成。這使 NMN 成為糞便微生物移植保護效應的重要介導者，並凸顯腸道菌叢產生的 NAD+ 前驅物在宿主病理結果中的作用。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Gut Microbiome

context.en-US: The gut microbiota can produce nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), and this microbe-derived NMN exerts protective effects on host tissues. NMN derived from gut microbiota ameliorated acute pancreatitis by increasing NAD+ levels and activating the SIRT3-PRDX5 pathway in mouse models, and normobiotic fecal microbiota transplantation induced higher NMN levels in serum while enhancing NAD+ biosynthesis in the pancreas. Gut bacteria also produce B vitamins and engage the deamidated NAD+ biosynthesis pathway, and microorganisms in fermented beverages can synthesize NMN and NR. This bidirectional axis positions gut microbes as sources of NAD+ precursors that influence host metabolism and disease outcomes.
context.zh-TW: 腸道菌叢能產生菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN），而這種微生物來源的 NMN 對宿主組織發揮保護作用。源自腸道菌叢的 NMN 在小鼠模型中透過提升 NAD+ 水平並活化 SIRT3-PRDX5 路徑改善急性胰臟炎，而正常菌叢糞便微生物移植誘導了較高的血清 NMN 水平，同時增強胰臟中的 NAD+ 生合成。腸道細菌也產生 B 群維生素並參與去醯胺化 NAD+ 生合成路徑，而發酵飲料中的微生物能合成 NMN 和 NR。這個雙向軸將腸道微生物定位為影響宿主代謝與疾病結果的 NAD+ 前驅物來源。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) can selectively stimulate the growth of beneficial gut bacteria such as Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus. These genera are associated with improved gut health, including prevention of diarrhea, improved gut barrier function, reduced inflammation, and immune system support. NAD+ precursors modulate gut microbiota by providing an energy source for beneficial bacteria, activating sirtuins, and improving gut barrier function. NMN and NR thereby reverse gut dysbiosis and promote beneficial effects at both intestinal and extraintestinal levels, linking dietary NAD+ precursor intake to a healthier gut microbial community.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）能選擇性地刺激有益腸道細菌如 Bifidobacterium 和 Lactobacillus 的生長。這些屬與改善腸道健康相關，包括預防腹瀉、改善腸道屏障功能、減少發炎以及支持免疫系統。NAD+ 前驅物透過提供有益細菌的能量來源、活化去乙醯酶以及改善腸道屏障功能來調節腸道菌叢。NMN 和 NR 因此逆轉腸道失調，並在腸內與腸外層面促進有益效應，將膳食性 NAD+ 前驅物攝取與更健康的腸道微生物群落連結起來。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) can selectively stimulate the growth of beneficial gut bacteria such as Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus. These bacteria are associated with improved gut health, including prevention of diarrhea, improved gut barrier function, reduced inflammation, and immune support. NR also modulates gut microbiota in ways protective against high-fat diet-induced weight gain: mice fed 60% HFD with 0.4% NR for 168 days had nearly 16% less weight gain and lower fasting blood glucose, and fecal transfer from NR-treated donors reproduced the protective effect with a microbiota enriched in butyrate-producing Firmicutes. NR thus reshapes the microbiome to favor metabolically beneficial bacteria.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）能選擇性地刺激有益腸道細菌如 Bifidobacterium 和 Lactobacillus 的生長。這些細菌與改善腸道健康相關，包括預防腹瀉、改善腸道屏障功能、減少發炎以及免疫支持。NR 也以對抗高脂飲食誘發體重增加的方式調節腸道菌叢：以含 0.4% NR 的 60% HFD 餵食 168 天的小鼠，體重增加減少近 16% 且空腹血糖較低，而來自 NR 處理供體的糞便移植重現了此保護效應，其菌叢富含產丁酸的 Firmicutes。NR 因此重塑微生物組以偏好代謝有益的細菌。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Long-term nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation modulates gut microbiota composition in humans, increasing the abundance of Faecalibacterium prausnitzii. In a twin study, NR at 250-1000 mg/day for 5 months raised F. prausnitzii abundance, and association analysis suggested this bacterium contributes to regulation of NAD+, inflammation, amino acid, and lipid metabolism. Faecalibacterium prausnitzii is a butyrate-producing commensal that promotes metabolic health and anti-inflammatory responses, and its decline characterizes dysbiosis in inflammatory bowel disease. NR's ability to enrich this beneficial organism supports its role in improving gut and systemic health through microbiota modulation.
context.zh-TW: 長期補充菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）調節人類腸道菌叢組成，增加 Faecalibacterium prausnitzii 的豐度。在一項雙生子研究中，每天 250-1000 mg NR 持續 5 個月提升了 F. prausnitzii 豐度，且關聯分析顯示此細菌有助於調節 NAD+、發炎、胺基酸與脂質代謝。Faecalibacterium prausnitzii 是一種產丁酸的共生菌，促進代謝健康與抗發炎反應，其減少是發炎性腸道疾病中菌叢失調的特徵。NR 富集此有益生物的能力支持其透過菌叢調節改善腸道與全身健康的角色。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) reverses gut dysbiosis and protects the intestinal tract. In an experimental mouse model of colitis induced by dextran sodium sulfate, NMN given by gavage at 1 mg/g body weight increased microbial abundance and diversity, improved mucus secretion and tight-junction protein expression, and attenuated intestinal mucosal permeability, protecting against inflammatory bowel disease. Long-term NMN treatment modulated gut microbiota diversity and composition, increasing butyric acid-producing bacteria such as Ruminococcaceae UCG-014 and Prevotellaceae NK3B31 as well as Akkermansia muciniphila, while decreasing harmful bacteria like Bilophila and Oscillibacter. NMN thereby restores intestinal homeostasis and barrier integrity through microbiota remodeling.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）逆轉腸道失調並保護腸道。在硫酸葡聚醣誘發的實驗性小鼠結腸炎模型中，以 1 mg/g 體重灌胃給予 NMN 增加了微生物豐度與多樣性，改善黏液分泌與緊密連接蛋白表現，並減輕腸黏膜通透性，防護發炎性腸道疾病。長期 NMN 處理調節腸道菌叢多樣性與組成，增加產丁酸細菌如 Ruminococcaceae UCG-014 和 Prevotellaceae NK3B31 以及 Akkermansia muciniphila，同時減少 Bilophila 和 Oscillibacter 等有害細菌。NMN 因此透過菌叢重塑恢復腸道恆定與屏障完整性。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) improves intestinal barrier function, which is important for preventing translocation of harmful bacteria and toxins from the gut into the bloodstream. In colitis models, NMN increased the expression of tight-junction proteins and improved mucus secretion, attenuating intestinal mucosal permeability. Long-term NMN treatment also increased the number of goblet cells, mucus thickness, and tight junction protein expression, maintaining the integrity of the intestinal epithelium. NMN and NR share this gut-protective property alongside selective stimulation of beneficial bacteria, and NAD+-precursor-activated sirtuins also protect intestinal endothelial cells against oxidative injury, collectively reinforcing the gut barrier.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）改善腸道屏障功能，這對於防止有害細菌與毒素從腸道移位至血流中相當重要。在結腸炎模型中，NMN 增加緊密連接蛋白的表現並改善黏液分泌，減輕腸黏膜通透性。長期 NMN 處理也增加杯狀細胞數量、黏液厚度與緊密連接蛋白表現，維持腸上皮的完整性。NMN 和 NR 共享此腸道保護特性，加上對有益細菌的選擇性刺激，且 NAD+ 前驅物活化的去乙醯酶也保護腸道內皮細胞免受氧化損傷，共同強化腸道屏障。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) protects against alcohol-induced depression-like behaviors in mice by altering gut microbiota composition. Dietary supplementation with NR for 10 weeks at 400 mg/kg daily reduced both pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokine levels, inhibited microglial activation, and provided protection against alcohol-induced depression-like behaviors. The effect was attributed to NR's ability to upregulate brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) through microbiota changes: brain BDNF levels correlated positively with bacteria enriched in the NR group such as Barnesiella, Alloprevotella, Prevotella, Alistipes, and Mucispirillum. Fecal microbiota transplantation from NR-treated donors reproduced the protective features in germ-free recipients, demonstrating a gut-microbiota-gut-brain axis mechanism.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）透過改變腸道菌叢組成，保護小鼠免於酒精誘發的類憂鬱行為。以每天 400 mg/kg NR 飲食補充 10 週，降低了促發炎與抗發炎細胞激素水平，抑制小膠質細胞活化，並提供對酒精誘發類憂鬱行為的保護。此效應歸因於 NR 透過菌叢改變上調腦源性神經營養因子（BDNF）的能力：腦部 BDNF 水平與 NR 組中富集的細菌如 Barnesiella、Alloprevotella、Prevotella、Alistipes 和 Mucispirillum 呈正相關。來自 NR 處理供體的糞便微生物移植在無菌受體中重現了保護特徵，證明了腸道菌叢—腸—腦軸機制。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) upregulates brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) by altering gut microbiota composition. In a mouse model of alcohol-induced depression, 10 weeks of NR supplementation reduced pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokines, inhibited microglial activation, and protected against depression-like behaviors, with the protective effect attributed to NR-driven increases in BDNF. Brain BDNF levels were positively correlated with bacteria abundant in NR-treated mice, such as Barnesiella and Alloprevotella, whereas brain inflammatory cytokines correlated with bacteria enriched in the depression model group. This BDNF upregulation via microbiota remodeling links NR intake to improved emotional behavior and neural plasticity.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）透過改變腸道菌叢組成上調腦源性神經營養因子（BDNF）。在酒精誘發憂鬱的小鼠模型中，10 週 NR 補充降低了促發炎與抗發炎細胞激素，抑制小膠質細胞活化，並保護免於類憂鬱行為，其保護效應歸因於 NR 驅動的 BDNF 增加。腦部 BDNF 水平與 NR 處理小鼠中豐富的細菌如 Barnesiella 和 Alloprevotella 呈正相關，而腦部發炎細胞激素則與憂鬱模型組中富集的細菌相關。這種透過菌叢重塑的 BDNF 上調將 NR 攝取與改善情緒行為及神經可塑性連結起來。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Butyrate

context.en-US: Butyrate, a short-chain fatty acid produced by gut bacteria such as Faecalibacterium prausnitzii, Eubacterium rectale, and Roseburia, reduces adiposity by inhibiting intestinal cholesterol biosynthesis and promoting beneficial metabolic effects including insulin secretion, insulin sensitivity, and energy expenditure. Butyrate can also increase satiety and gut motility by upregulating the expression of peptide YY and glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1). In studies where NR supplementation enriched butyrate-producing Firmicutes, these metabolic benefits contributed to protection against high-fat diet-induced weight gain, and fecal transfer reproduced the effect, underscoring butyrate as a key mediator of microbiota-driven metabolic health.
context.zh-TW: 丁酸是一種由腸道細菌如 Faecalibacterium prausnitzii、Eubacterium rectale 和 Roseburia 產生的短鏈脂肪酸，透過抑制腸道膽固醇生合成並促進包括胰島素分泌、胰島素敏感性與能量消耗在內的有益代謝效應來減少肥胖。丁酸也能透過上調 peptide YY 與類升糖素胜肽-1（GLP-1）的表現來增加飽足感與腸道蠕動。在 NR 補充富集產丁酸 Firmicutes 的研究中，這些代謝益處有助於防護高脂飲食誘發的體重增加，且糞便移植重現了此效應，凸顯丁酸作為微生物群驅動代謝健康的關鍵介導者。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: NAD+

context.en-US: NAD+ can directly affect the metabolism of intestinal microorganisms. Because NAD+ is an important component in the energy metabolism of all living organisms, mainly as a cofactor for key enzymes involved in cellular ATP production, boosting NAD+ may promote microbial energy production. NAD+ can also indirectly affect gut microbes by regulating the movement of the colon through the key inhibitory neurotransmitter beta-NAD and by affecting the synthesis of host bile acids, which can be antimicrobial when they destroy bacterial cell membranes. These mechanisms complement the ability of NMN and NR to modulate gut microbiota composition, forming a bidirectional NAD+-microbiota axis.
context.zh-TW: NAD+ 能直接影響腸道微生物的代謝。由於 NAD+ 是所有生物能量代謝中的重要組成，主要作為參與細胞 ATP 生成的關鍵酶的輔因子，提升 NAD+ 可能促進微生物能量生成。NAD+ 也能透過關鍵抑制性神經傳導物質 beta-NAD 調節結腸運動，以及透過影響宿主膽汁酸的合成（當其破壞細菌細胞膜時可具抗菌作用）間接影響腸道微生物。這些機制補充了 NMN 和 NR 調節腸道菌叢組成的能力，形成雙向的 NAD+—微生物群軸。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is found in a range of foods including edamame beans, avocado, broccoli, cucumber, cabbage, and tomato, according to the first evidence published by Mills et al. (2016). Among the investigated sources, the highest NMN content was found in edamame at 0.47-1.88 mg/100 g and avocado at 0.36-1.60 mg/100 g, with smaller amounts in seafood and raw meats (0.06-0.42 mg/100 g). Milk also contains NMN, with human milk the richest source at 2.1-9.8 uM. These natural occurrences support the idea that a normal diet can contribute to NAD+ precursor intake, though optimal sources remain to be established.
context.zh-TW: 根據 Mills 等人（2016）發表的首批證據，菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）存在於一系列食物中，包括毛豆、酪梨、花椰菜、小黃瓜、高麗菜和番茄。在受調查的來源中，NMN 含量最高的是毛豆（0.47-1.88 mg/100 g）和酪梨（0.36-1.60 mg/100 g），海鮮與生肉中含量較少（0.06-0.42 mg/100 g）。牛奶也含有 NMN，其中人乳是最豐富的來源，達 2.1-9.8 uM。這些天然存在支持正常飲食可貢獻 NAD+ 前驅物攝取的概念，儘管最佳來源仍有待確立。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) was first discovered in milk and, until recently, had only been measured there. Bovine milk contains the highest NR content among milk sources at 0.5-3.6 uM, while human milk is the richest source of nicotinamide mononucleotide at 2.1-9.8 uM. NR and NMN are also determined in different species of milk and beer. The niacin quantified by microbiological assay (AOAC Method 944.13) actually includes NR and NMN, because hot acid or alkaline extraction hydrolyzes these molecules into nicotinic acid, meaning NR and NMN contribute to the measured niacin content of milk and other foods.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）最早在牛奶中被發現，且直到最近都只在那裡被測得。牛乳在乳源中 NR 含量最高，達 0.5-3.6 uM，而人乳是菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸最豐富的來源，達 2.1-9.8 uM。NR 和 NMN 也在不同物種的乳汁與啤酒中被測定。以微生物分析法（AOAC Method 944.13）定量出的菸鹼酸實際上包含 NR 和 NMN，因為熱酸或鹼性萃取會將這些分子水解為菸鹼酸，意味著 NR 和 NMN 貢獻了牛奶與其他食物中測得的菸鹼酸含量。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Saccharomyces cerevisiae

context.en-US: Yeast-mediated production of nicotinamide riboside (NR) and nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) was demonstrated in craft beers, with hop indicating a role in enhancing NR levels during fermentation. This finding opens new perspectives for enriched sources of NAD+ precursors through fermented foods and beverages. Additionally, fructophilic lactic acid bacteria have been investigated for biotechnological production of NMN and NR for functional probiotic products and supplements. These microbial routes complement natural dietary sources such as vegetables, meat, milk, and mushrooms, and could enable the development of new functional foods and biotechnological strategies to maintain and enhance the physiological benefits of NAD+ precursors.
context.zh-TW: 在精釀啤酒中證實了酵母介導的菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）與菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）生成，其中啤酒花顯示在發酵過程中提升 NR 水平的作用。此發現為透過發酵食物與飲料獲得富集的 NAD+ 前驅物來源開啟了新視角。此外，嗜果糖乳酸菌已被研究用於 NMN 和 NR 的生物技術生產，以製造功能性益生菌產品與補充劑。這些微生物途徑補充了蔬菜、肉類、牛奶和蘑菇等天然膳食來源，並可能促成新功能性食品與生物技術策略的發展，以維持並增強 NAD+ 前驅物的生理益處。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: A sub-chronic 90-day toxicity study in rats established that repeated oral administration of synthetic NMN at doses up to 1500 mg/kg/day appears safe and did not promote toxic effects on body weight, food and water consumption, feed conversion efficiency, or biochemical and blood parameters, although higher doses increased kidney, liver, and adrenal gland weights and elevated hepatic enzymes such as alkaline phosphatase, alanine aminotransferase, and aspartate aminotransferase. Based on these findings, the established upper intake level of NMN for a 60 kg individual was set at 900 mg per day. Human studies at 100-500 mg single doses and 250-300 mg/day over weeks to months reported no adverse effects.
context.zh-TW: 一項大鼠亞慢性 90 天毒性研究確立，重複口服高達 1500 mg/kg/天的合成 NMN 似乎安全，且未對體重、食物與水分攝取、飼料轉換效率或生化與血液參數產生毒性效應，儘管較高劑量增加了腎臟、肝臟與腎上腺重量，並提升了鹼性磷酸酶、丙胺酸轉胺酶與天門冬胺酸轉胺酶等肝酶。基於這些發現，60 kg 個體的 NMN 既定上限攝取量設定為每天 900 mg。人體研究中，100-500 mg 單次劑量以及 250-300 mg/天持續數週至數月均未報告不良反應。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is unstable in blood, degrading very rapidly even at -80 degrees Celsius. In the first clinical trial of single oral NMN doses (100-500 mg) in healthy subjects, NMN was not detected in plasma, most likely because sample freezing before extraction caused NMN degradation. This rapid degradation complicates accurate measurement of circulating NMN and may explain why plasma NMN levels are kept low and constant, presumably due to balanced NMN distribution from plasma to tissues. In mice, orally administered NMN was quickly absorbed from the intestine, eliminated from circulation within 15 minutes, and rapidly converted into NAD+ in tissues such as the liver and soleus muscle.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）在血液中不穩定，即使在 -80 攝氏度下也會極快速地降解。在首項健康受試者單次口服 NMN 劑量（100-500 mg）的臨床試驗中，血漿中未檢出 NMN，最可能的原因是萃取前樣本冷凍導致 NMN 降解。這種快速降解使循環 NMN 的準確測量變得複雜，並可能解釋為何血漿 NMN 水平維持在低且恆定的狀態，推測是由於 NMN 從血漿到組織的平衡分佈。在小鼠中，口服給予的 NMN 迅速從腸道吸收，在 15 分鐘內從循環中清除，並在肝臟與比目魚肌等組織中快速轉化為 NAD+。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide

context.en-US: Although nicotinamide (NAM) effectively increases NAD+ in tissues, it also exerts an inhibitory effect on sirtuins and PARP activity, a property that distinguishes it from the other precursors NMN and NR. At high doses, NAM is methylated by nicotinamide N-methyltransferase to generate N1-methylnicotinamide for elimination in urine, which can lower the cellular methyl pool over time. This depletion could reduce DNA and protein methylation and alter gene expression patterns and protein activity, since DNA methylation in gene promoter regions is typically associated with transcriptional repression. These effects may explain why NR administration raises NAD+ levels more than NAM treatment in some studies.
context.zh-TW: 儘管菸鹼醯胺（NAM）能有效提升組織中的 NAD+，它同時對去乙醯酶與 PARP 活性產生抑制作用，此特性使其有別於其他前驅物 NMN 和 NR。在高劑量下，NAM 被菸鹼醯胺 N-甲基轉移酶甲基化，生成 N1-甲基菸鹼醯胺以經尿液排出，這可能隨時間降低細胞甲基池。此耗竭可能減少 DNA 與蛋白質甲基化並改變基因表現模式與蛋白質活性，因為基因啟動子區域的 DNA 甲基化通常與轉錄抑制相關。這些效應可能解釋為何在部分研究中 NR 給藥比 NAM 處理更能提升 NAD+ 水平。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide (NAM), the amide form of vitamin B3 and a product released from NAD+-consuming reactions, inhibits PARP activity while being effective at increasing NAD+ levels in tissues. At high doses, NAM is metabolized by nicotinamide N-methyltransferase into N1-methylnicotinamide for urinary elimination, which can progressively lower the cellular methyl pool, potentially reducing DNA and protein methylation and altering gene expression and protein activity. This dual role as both NAD+ precursor and PARP/sirtuin inhibitor distinguishes NAM from NMN and NR, which elevate NAD+ without this inhibitory action, and may explain differences in their metabolic outcomes.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺（NAM）是維生素 B3 的醯胺形式，也是 NAD+ 消耗反應釋放的產物，它在有效提升組織 NAD+ 水平的同時抑制 PARP 活性。在高劑量下，NAM 被菸鹼醯胺 N-甲基轉移酶代謝為 N1-甲基菸鹼醯胺以經尿液排出，這可能逐步降低細胞甲基池，潛在減少 DNA 與蛋白質甲基化並改變基因表現與蛋白質活性。這種同時作為 NAD+ 前驅物與 PARP/去乙醯酶抑制劑的雙重角色，使 NAM 有別於 NMN 和 NR——後者提升 NAD+ 而不具此抑制作用，並可能解釋其代謝結果的差異。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: NRH

context.en-US: NRH (dihydronicotinamide riboside) is the reduced form of nicotinamide riboside and has recently been shown to promote NAD+ synthesis. Alongside NMNH (dihydronicotinamide mononucleotide), the reduced form of nicotinamide mononucleotide, NRH expands the repertoire of NAD+ precursors beyond the amidated molecules nicotinamide, NMN, and NR. These reduced precursors are additional substrates for the salvage pathway and are considered orally bioavailable NAD+ precursors. Their discovery illustrates the redundancy of NAD+ biosynthetic routes and suggests that multiple dietary and pharmacological compounds can contribute to maintaining intracellular NAD+ levels across tissues.
context.zh-TW: NRH（二氫菸鹼醯胺核糖）是菸鹼醯胺核糖的還原形式，最近被證實能促進 NAD+ 生合成。與 NMNH（二氫菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸，即菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸的還原形式）一起，NRH 將 NAD+ 前驅物的範疇擴展到醯胺化分子菸鹼醯胺、NMN 和 NR 之外。這些還原型前驅物是回收路徑的額外受質，被視為口服具生物可利用性的 NAD+ 前驅物。它們的發現說明了 NAD+ 生合成路徑的冗餘性，並顯示多種膳食與藥理化合物可貢獻於維持跨組織的細胞內 NAD+ 水平。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: NMNH

context.en-US: NMNH (dihydronicotinamide mononucleotide) is the reduced form of nicotinamide mononucleotide and has been shown to promote NAD+ synthesis. Together with NRH, the reduced form of nicotinamide riboside, NMNH adds to the set of NAD+ precursors available for cellular salvage and NAD+ replenishment. These reduced precursors demonstrate that the NAD+ metabolic cycle is more flexible than initially recognized, providing alternative routes to boost NAD+ levels beyond the classic precursors tryptophan, nicotinamide, nicotinic acid, NMN, and NR, and supporting efforts to develop effective strategies for preventing NAD+ decline in aging and disease.
context.zh-TW: NMNH（二氫菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸）是菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸的還原形式，已被證實能促進 NAD+ 生合成。與 NRH（菸鹼醯胺核糖的還原形式）一起，NMNH 加入了可供細胞回收與 NAD+ 補充的 NAD+ 前驅物組合。這些還原型前驅物顯示 NAD+ 代謝循環比最初所認知的更具彈性，提供了超越經典前驅物色胺酸、菸鹼醯胺、菸鹼酸、NMN 和 NR 之外提升 NAD+ 水平的替代途徑，並支持開發有效策略以預防老化與疾病中的 NAD+ 衰退。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: SLC12A8

context.en-US: SLC12A8 is a transporter encoded by the gene SLC12A8 that has been proposed to mediate cellular uptake of nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), in addition to the CD73-mediated dephosphorylation route in which NMN is converted extracellularly to nicotinamide riboside for uptake. The expression of a gut transporter reinforces that NMN could be made bioavailable through oral delivery, and the presence of such a transporter in the intestine supports the idea that dietary NMN can enter the circulation. These uptake mechanisms complement each other and explain how orally administered NMN is rapidly absorbed from the intestine into the bloodstream and converted to NAD+ in tissues.
context.zh-TW: SLC12A8 是由基因 SLC12A8 編碼的轉運蛋白，被認為除了 CD73 介導的去磷酸化途徑（NMN 在細胞外轉化為菸鹼醯胺核糖以供吸收）之外，還介導菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）的細胞攝取。腸道轉運蛋白的表現強化了 NMN 可透過口服遞送達成生物可利用性的觀點，而此類轉運蛋白在腸道中的存在支持膳食性 NMN 能進入循環的構想。這些攝取機制互補，並解釋了口服給予的 NMN 如何從腸道快速吸收進入血流並在組織中轉化為 NAD+。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: NAAD

context.en-US: NAAD (nicotinic acid adenine dinucleotide) is a product of NR utilization in humans and a biomarker of increased NAD+ metabolism. NR supplementation raised NAAD by 4.5-fold in blood, and healthy middle-aged adults taking 1 g/day NR for 6 weeks showed around a fivefold increase in blood NAAD. In another study, NAAD was undetectable before NR supplementation but increased by approximately 2,900% after single doses of up to 1 g NR. These findings corroborate studies in mice showing that the deamidated Preiss-Handler pathway predominates after NR intake, making NAAD a sensitive readout of the deamidated route of NAD+ precursor metabolism.
context.zh-TW: NAAD（菸鹼酸腺嘌呤二核苷酸）是 NR 在人體中利用的產物，也是 NAD+ 代謝增加的生物標記。NR 補充使血液中 NAAD 提升 4.5 倍，而每天攝取 1 g NR 達 6 週的健康中年人，其血液 NAAD 增加約五倍。在另一項研究中，NAAD 在 NR 補充前無法檢出，但在單次高達 1 g NR 劑量後增加了約 2,900%。這些發現佐證了小鼠研究中顯示 NR 攝取後去醯胺化 Preiss-Handler 路徑佔主導地位，使 NAAD 成為 NAD+ 前驅物代謝去醯胺化途徑的敏感讀值。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation substantially increases NAAD (nicotinic acid adenine dinucleotide) levels, indicating flux through the deamidated Preiss-Handler pathway. Oral NR raised NAAD by 4.5-fold alongside more than twofold increases in NAD+ and 1.4-fold increases in NMN. Martens et al. reported about a fivefold increase in NAAD in blood of healthy middle-aged adults supplemented with 1 g/day NR for 6 weeks, and single doses of 100-1000 mg NR produced a roughly 2,900% increase in NAAD from undetectable baseline. NAAD is therefore a product and biomarker of NR metabolism that confirms the predominance of the deamidated route after NR intake.
context.zh-TW: 補充菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）大幅提升 NAAD（菸鹼酸腺嘌呤二核苷酸）水平，顯示流經去醯胺化 Preiss-Handler 路徑。口服 NR 使 NAAD 提升 4.5 倍，同時 NAD+ 增加超過兩倍、NMN 增加 1.4 倍。Martens 等人報告，每天補充 1 g NR 達 6 週的健康中年人血液中 NAAD 增加約五倍，而 100-1000 mg 單次 NR 劑量使 NAAD 從無法檢出的基線增加約 2,900%。因此，NAAD 是 NR 代謝的產物與生物標記，證實了 NR 攝取後去醯胺化途徑的優勢地位。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: In an oncogenic mouse model, supplementation with NMN (500 mg/kg body weight daily for 13 days) significantly increased the secretory phenotype associated with pro-inflammatory senescence, promoting pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma progression. This raises the hypothesis that dietary supplements that increase NAD+ may be tumorigenic in vivo under stress conditions such as premalignant senescent lesions induced by activated oncogenes. The finding highlights the complex, context-dependent interplay between NAD+ metabolism and cancer biology, cautioning that NAD+ precursor supplementation could accelerate tumorigenesis in certain premalignant settings even as it confers health benefits in normal aging and metabolic disease.
context.zh-TW: 在致癌小鼠模型中，補充 NMN（每天 500 mg/kg 體重，持續 13 天）顯著增加了與促發炎性衰老相關的分泌型態，促進胰管腺癌的進展。這提出了這樣的假說：在活化致癌基因誘發的癌前衰老病變等壓力條件下，提升 NAD+ 的膳食補充劑可能在體內具有致癌性。此發現凸顯了 NAD+ 代謝與癌症生物學之間複雜且依賴情境的相互作用，並警示儘管 NAD+ 前驅物補充在正常老化與代謝疾病中帶來健康益處，但在某些癌前情境中可能加速腫瘤發生。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Combined Metabolic Activators

context.en-US: Combined metabolic activators (CMAs), consisting of NR (1 g), l-carnitine tartrate (3.73 g), N-acetylcysteine (2.55 g), and serine (12.35 g), improved COVID-19 outcomes in clinical trials. Patients taking the mixture orally for 14 days had significantly faster complete recovery times than placebo (6.6 vs 9.3 days in a phase 2 study and 5.7 vs 9.2 days in a phase 3 study). CMAs were found to reinforce the immune response and regulate amino acid and lipid metabolism, and patients showed improvements in plasma levels of inflammation and antioxidant metabolism-related biomarkers including alanine aminotransferase, lactate dehydrogenase, creatinine, glucose, and proteins. NR within the mixture contributes NAD+ restoration supporting antiviral PARP function.
context.zh-TW: 合併代謝活化劑（CMAs）由 NR（1 g）、酒石酸左旋肉鹼（3.73 g）、N-乙醯半胱胺酸（2.55 g）和絲胺酸（12.35 g）組成，在臨床試驗中改善了 COVID-19 結果。口服此混合物 14 天的患者，其完全康復時間顯著快於安慰劑組（第二期研究為 6.6 對 9.3 天，第三期研究為 5.7 對 9.2 天）。CMAs 被發現能強化免疫反應並調節胺基酸與脂質代謝，且患者的發炎與抗氧化代謝相關生物標記血漿水平有所改善，包括丙胺酸轉胺酶、乳酸脫氫酶、肌酸酐、葡萄糖與蛋白質。混合物中的 NR 有助於 NAD+ 恢復，支持抗病毒 PARP 功能。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: A case study of 10 critically ill COVID-19 patients over 50 years old reported that an NMN cocktail (83 mL of NMN mixed with 400 mL of water, consumed before breakfast and dinner) was strongly associated with resolution of COVID-19 symptoms. Before treatment, patients had low oxygen saturation, pulmonary infiltrates, and inflammation; post-treatment there was rapid improvement in bilateral pulmonary infiltrates, fever resolution, and lower inflammation biomarkers. One patient who stopped treatment after 3 days experienced relapse with fever and pulmonary infiltrates 8 days later. The rapid clinical improvement suggests NMN may help reverse the potentially fatal cytokine storm triggered by SARS-CoV-2, though larger controlled studies are needed.
context.zh-TW: 一項針對 10 名 50 歲以上重症 COVID-19 患者的病例研究報告，NMN 雞尾酒（83 mL NMN 混合 400 mL 水，於早餐與晚餐前飲用）與 COVID-19 症狀的緩解強烈相關。治療前，患者血氧飽和度低、有肺部浸潤與發炎；治療後雙側肺部浸潤迅速改善、退燒，且發炎生物標記下降。一名患者在 3 天後停止治療，8 天後出現發燒與肺部浸潤的復發。快速的臨床改善顯示 NMN 可能有助於逆轉 SARS-CoV-2 觸發的潛在致命細胞激素風暴，儘管仍需要更大規模的對照研究。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: PARP

context.en-US: PARPs play a critical antiviral role by inhibiting the translation of viral transcripts through ADP-ribosylation of the viral genome, a process requiring NAD+. However, several viral families including SARS-CoV encode a macrodomain protein that hydrolyses the ADPR units from proteins and nucleic acids, inhibiting this PARP protective effect and facilitating replication and virulence. Excessive PARP activation then occurs to compensate for ADPR hydrolysis, accompanied by NAD+ consumption. This suggests that increasing NAD+ levels may restore the antiviral functions of PARPs to support immunity against SARS-CoV-2, providing a rationale for NAD+ precursor supplementation in COVID-19.
context.zh-TW: PARPs 透過對病毒基因組進行 ADP-核糖基化以抑制病毒轉錄本的轉譯，發揮關鍵的抗病毒作用，此過程需要 NAD+。然而，包括 SARS-CoV 在內的數個病毒家族編碼一種 macrodomain 蛋白，可水解蛋白質與核酸上的 ADPR 單元，抑制此 PARP 保護效應並促進複製與毒力。隨後發生過度的 PARP 活化以補償 ADPR 水解，伴隨 NAD+ 消耗。這顯示提升 NAD+ 水平可能恢復 PARPs 的抗病毒功能以支持對抗 SARS-CoV-2 的免疫力，為 COVID-19 中 NAD+ 前驅物補充提供了理據。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain

context.en-US: The SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain is a viral protein that hydrolyses the ADP-ribose (ADPR) units added by PARPs to proteins and nucleic acids, thereby inhibiting the protective antiviral effect of PARPs and facilitating viral replication and virulence. Because PARPs require NAD+ to ADP-ribosylate viral transcripts, this counteraction leads to excessive PARP activation and NAD+ consumption during infection, dysregulating the NAD+ metabolome. Restoring NAD+ levels with precursors may therefore restore PARP antiviral function and support innate immunity to SARS-CoV-2, connecting NAD+ metabolism directly to COVID-19 severity and immune defense.
context.zh-TW: SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain 是一種病毒蛋白，可水解 PARPs 加到蛋白質與核酸上的 ADP-核糖（ADPR）單元，從而抑制 PARPs 的保護性抗病毒效應並促進病毒複製與毒力。由於 PARPs 需要 NAD+ 來對病毒轉錄本進行 ADP-核糖基化，此對抗作用導致感染期間過度的 PARP 活化與 NAD+ 消耗，使 NAD+ 代謝組失調。因此，以前驅物恢復 NAD+ 水平可能恢復 PARP 抗病毒功能並支持對 SARS-CoV-2 的先天免疫，將 NAD+ 代謝直接連結到 COVID-19 嚴重程度與免疫防禦。

source_document: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md

subject: SIRT6

context.en-US: SIRT6 attenuates NF-kB signaling via histone H3 lysine 9 (H3K9) deacetylation at the chromatin of NF-kB target gene promoters, which are related to apoptosis and cellular senescence. Alongside SIRT1, SIRT2, and SIRT3, which suppress both NF-kB and NLRP3 inflammasome activity through multiple mechanisms, SIRT6 helps coordinate the intensity of inflammatory responses and prevent cytokine storms. Because sirtuins are NAD+-dependent, NAD+ precursor supplementation that raises NAD+ levels can reinforce this sirtuin-mediated restraint of NF-kB-driven inflammation, linking NAD+ metabolism to control of the pro-inflammatory transcription program during infection and aging.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 透過在 NF-kB 標的基因啟動子的染色質上進行組蛋白 H3 離胺酸 9（H3K9）去乙醯化，減弱 NF-kB 訊息傳導，這些基因與凋亡和細胞衰老相關。與 SIRT1、SIRT2 和 SIRT3 一起——後者透過多種機制抑制 NF-kB 與 NLRP3 發炎體活性——SIRT6 協助協調發炎反應的強度並預防細胞激素風暴。由於去乙醯酶是 NAD+ 依賴性的，提升 NAD+ 水平的 NAD+ 前驅物補充可強化此去乙醯酶介導的 NF-kB 驅動發炎抑制，將 NAD+ 代謝連結到感染與老化期間促發炎轉錄程式的控制。

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) enhances aerobic capacity, as demonstrated in a randomized, double-blind study in amateur runners. NMN also improves mitochondrial function and energy metabolism: long-term administration in drinking water at 100 or 300 mg/kg/day for 12 months increased mitochondrial respiratory ability in skeletal muscle and reversed age-associated gene expression changes in a tissue-specific manner in aged mice. These mitochondrial and aerobic benefits are attributed to NMN raising NAD+ levels, which activates sirtuins and supports oxidative metabolism, energy expenditure, and oxygen consumption, positioning NMN as a performance- and healthspan-enhancing NAD+ precursor.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）增強有氧能力，此點已在一項針對業餘跑者的隨機雙盲研究中獲證實。NMN 也改善粒線體功能與能量代謝：在飲用水中以 100 或 300 mg/kg/天長期給藥 12 個月，增加了骨骼肌的粒線體呼吸能力，並以組織特異性方式逆轉老化小鼠中與年齡相關的基因表現變化。這些粒線體與有氧益處歸因於 NMN 提升 NAD+ 水平，進而活化去乙醯酶並支持氧化代謝、能量消耗與氧氣消耗，使 NMN 成為增進表現與健康壽命的 NAD+ 前驅物。

subject: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) rescues endothelial dysfunction associated with aging. In aged mice, intraperitoneal NMN at 500 mg/kg/day for 14 days reversed aging-induced cerebrovascular endothelial dysfunction and rescued neurovascular coupling responses, improving cognitive performance by increasing endothelial NO-mediated vasodilation. NMN also restored angiogenic capacity (capillary-like structure formation, proliferative and migratory capability) and attenuated oxidative stress in aged cerebromicrovascular endothelial cells. These vascular protective effects, which depend on NAD+ restoration and likely SIRT1 activation, prevent arterial and endothelial dysfunction and support NMN's role in preserving cardiovascular and cognitive health during aging.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）挽救與老化相關的內皮功能障礙。在老化小鼠中，以 500 mg/kg/天腹腔注射 NMN 14 天，逆轉了老化誘發的腦血管內皮功能障礙並挽救神經血管耦合反應，透過增加內皮 NO 介導的血管舒張改善認知表現。NMN 也恢復了血管生成能力（毛細血管樣結構形成、增殖與遷移能力），並減輕老化腦微血管內皮細胞中的氧化壓力。這些依賴 NAD+ 恢復且可能依賴 SIRT1 活化的血管保護效應，預防動脈與內皮功能障礙，並支持 NMN 在老化期間維持心血管與認知健康的角色。

subject: Hyperglycemia

context.en-US: The hallmark hyperglycemia of diabetes mellitus causes a redox imbalance between NAD+ and NADH that can lead to oxidative stress and a variety of metabolic syndromes. In cells whose glucose uptake is not insulin-dependent, glucose oversupply leads to NADH overproduction by both the conventional glucose combustion pathways (glycolysis and the Krebs cycle) and the polyol pathway. This NAD+/NADH imbalance, also known as pseudohypoxia, initially causes reductive stress and mitochondrial overload and dysfunction, which lead to oxidative stress and oxidative damage to DNA, lipids, and proteins. Additionally, PARP overactivation depletes NAD+, and this redox imbalance is a major factor contributing to the development of diabetic complications.
context.zh-TW: 糖尿病的標誌性高血糖造成 NAD+ 與 NADH 之間的氧化還原失衡，可能導致氧化壓力與多種代謝症候群。在葡萄糖攝取不依賴胰島素的細胞中，葡萄糖過量供給透過傳統的葡萄糖燃燒路徑（糖解作用與克氏循環）以及多元醇路徑導致 NADH 過度生成。這種 NAD+/NADH 失衡，亦稱為假性缺氧，最初造成還原壓力與粒線體超載及功能障礙，進而導致氧化壓力以及對 DNA、脂質與蛋白質的氧化損傷。此外，PARP 過度活化耗竭 NAD+，而此氧化還原失衡是促成糖尿病併發症發展的主要因素。

subject: CD38 knockdown

context.en-US: CD38 knockdown in mice suppressed axon degeneration, demyelination, and immune cell infiltration after facial nerve axotomy compared with wild-type mice, identifying CD38 as a candidate molecule for regulating neurodegeneration. Correspondingly, intraperitoneal injection of NR at 400 mg/kg once daily for 1 week prior to facial nerve axotomy delayed axon degeneration and demyelination and significantly increased NAD+ levels in the facial nucleus and facial nerve of wild-type mice. These findings connect the age-related rise in CD38 activity to NAD+ depletion and axonal vulnerability, and show that NAD+ precursor supplementation can mimic the protection achieved by CD38 deletion.
context.zh-TW: 小鼠中 CD38 敲低與野生型小鼠相比，抑制了面神經軸突切斷後的軸突退化、髓鞘脫失與免疫細胞浸潤，將 CD38 確認為調節神經退化的候選分子。相應地，在面神經軸突切斷前，以 400 mg/kg 的 NR 每日一次腹腔注射一週，延遲了軸突退化與髓鞘脫失，並顯著提升野生型小鼠面神經核與面神經中的 NAD+ 水平。這些發現將年齡相關的 CD38 活性上升與 NAD+ 耗竭及軸突脆弱性相連結，並顯示 NAD+ 前體補充能模擬 CD38 缺失所達成的保護作用。

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) delays axon degeneration and demyelination in a facial nerve axotomy model. Intraperitoneal injection of NR at 400 mg/kg once daily for 1 week prior to facial nerve axotomy delayed axon degeneration and demyelination and significantly increased NAD+ levels in the facial nucleus and facial nerve of wild-type mice, mimicking the protective effect of CD38 knockdown. Because the age-related increase in CD38 activity degrades NMN and NAD+ and alters precursor pharmacokinetics, NR-mediated NAD+ replenishment helps maintain axonal integrity after injury, supporting NR as a candidate intervention for neurodegeneration.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）在面神經軸突切斷模型中延遲軸突退化與脫髓鞘。在面神經軸突切斷前，以 400 mg/kg 的 NR 每日一次腹腔注射、持續 1 週，延遲了軸突退化與脫髓鞘，並顯著提升野生型小鼠面神經核與面神經中的 NAD+ 濃度，模擬了 CD38 敲低的保護作用。由於隨年齡增加的 CD38 活性會降解 NMN 與 NAD+，並改變前驅物的藥物動力學，NR 介導的 NAD+ 補充有助於在受傷後維持軸突完整性，支持 NR 作為神經退化性疾病的候選介入手段。

subject: Niacin

context.en-US: Nicotinic acid (niacin) at pharmacological doses reduces serum cholesterol levels in humans, but its clinical use is limited by a side effect of skin flushing accompanied by an unpleasant warmth sensation and often itching. Niacin, together with tryptophan and nicotinamide, is one of the classic NAD+ biosynthesis precursors historically used to prevent and treat pellagra, a disease characterized by dermatitis, diarrhea, and dementia. Tryptophan alone is not sufficient to sustain cellular NAD+ levels because it participates in other metabolic pathways such as serotonin, melatonin, and picolinic acid synthesis, making nicotinic acid an important dietary NAD+ precursor with distinct pharmacological actions.
context.zh-TW: Nicotinic acid (niacin) 在藥理劑量下可降低人類的血清膽固醇水平，但其臨床使用受限於皮膚潮紅的副作用，伴隨令人不適的溫熱感，且常伴隨搔癢。Niacin 與 tryptophan 及 nicotinamide 同為歷來用於預防和治療 pellagra 的經典 NAD+ 生合成前驅物，該疾病以皮膚炎、腹瀉和癡呆為特徵。單靠 tryptophan 不足以維持細胞內 NAD+ 水平，因為它參與其他代謝途徑，如 serotonin、melatonin 和 picolinic acid 的合成，使得 nicotinic acid 成為一種具有獨特藥理作用的重要膳食 NAD+ 前驅物。

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) is one of the most studied nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) precursors, and it is the third NAD+ precursor discovered, naturally occurring in milk and already commercially available as a nutraceutical. Alongside nicotinamide (NAM), nicotinic acid (NA), and nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), NR feeds into NAD+ biosynthetic salvage pathways and is regarded as a favorable precursor because it lacks the serious side effects and flushing attributed to other NAD+ precursors, and because its chloride salt has been granted GRAS (generally regarded as safe) status.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）是研究最廣泛的菸鹼醯胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD+）前驅物之一，也是被發現的第三種 NAD+ 前驅物，天然存在於牛奶中，且已作為營養補充品商業化供應。與菸鹼醯胺（NAM）、菸鹼酸（NA）以及菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）並列，NR 進入 NAD+ 生物合成補救途徑，被視為一種理想的前驅物，因為它沒有歸因於其他 NAD+ 前驅物的嚴重副作用與潮紅反應，且其氯化物鹽已被授予 GRAS（generally regarded as safe）地位。

source_document: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) is a salvageable NAD+ precursor that forms NAD+ through a two-step or three-step pathway. In the two-step route, NR is directly phosphorylated to nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) by the nicotinamide ribose kinases NMRK1 and NMRK2, and NMN is then converted to NAD+ by NMN/NaMN adenylyltransferases (NMNAT). Alternatively, NR can first be converted to nicotinamide by purine nucleoside phosphorylase, after which nicotinamide enters the NAMPT-dependent route. context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）是一種可被回收的 NAD+ 前驅物，可透過兩步或三步途徑形成 NAD+。在兩步路徑中，NR 由菸鹼醯胺核糖激酶 NMRK1 與 NMRK2 直接磷酸化為菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN），隨後 NMN 再由 NMN/NaMN 腺苷酸轉移酶（NMNAT）轉化為 NAD+。或者，NR 可先經嘌呤核苷磷酸化酶轉化為菸鹼醯胺，之後菸鹼醯胺進入 NAMPT 依賴性途徑。NAD+ 是一種必需的輔酶，參與糖解作用、脂肪酸 β-氧化以及三羧酸循環，而提升其含量是治療廣泛
