subject: Niacin

context.en-US: Niacin was previously suggested as an anti-inflammatory therapy in a preclinical study as a potent agent to decrease proinflammatory cytokines, including IL-1, IL-6, and TNF-alpha, and it might also decrease neutrophil infiltration while exhibiting a prolonged anti-inflammatory effect during ventilator-induced lung injury. Nicotinamide riboside (NR) can similarly decrease IL-2, IL-5, IL-6, and TNF-alpha. Targeting IL-6 has been proposed as a promising treatment to block the inflammatory storm, especially in severe COVID-19 patients.
context.zh-TW: Niacin（菸鹼酸）先前在臨床前研究中被提議作為抗發炎療法，是一種能降低促發炎性細胞激素（包括 IL-1、IL-6 與 TNF-alpha）的有效藥劑，且其亦可能減少嗜中性球浸潤，同時在呼吸器誘發的肺損傷期間展現持久的抗炎效果。nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）同樣能降低 IL-2、IL-5、IL-6 與 TNF-alpha。針對 IL-6 已被提議為阻斷發炎風暴（尤其是重症 COVID-19 患者）的有前景療法。

source_document: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

subject: Vitamin B3

context.en-US: High efficiency of vitamin B3 (niacin or nicotinamide) in preventing lung tissue damage was confirmed in several animal models with bleomycin- and LPS-induced lung injury, and considering this strong lung-protective effect, vitamin B3 has been proposed as an early treatment-supporting agent against COVID-19, which otherwise causes a maladaptive hyperinflammatory response with a cytokine storm in lung tissue. Nicotinamide riboside (NR), as a vitamin B3 derivative, is therefore considered a potential therapeutic or supporting agent to reduce hyperinflammation and regenerate damaged lung tissue during SARS-CoV-2 infection, where excess leucocyte infiltration causes extensive tissue damage
context.zh-TW: 維生素 B3（niacin 或 nicotinamide）在預防肺組織損傷方面的高效性已在數種 bleomycin（博萊黴素）與 LPS 誘發肺損傷的動物模型中獲得證實，且考量到此強效的肺保護效果，維生素 B3 已被提議作為對抗 COVID-19 的早期治療支援劑，否則 COVID-19 會在肺組織中引發伴隨細胞激素風暴的適應不良過度發炎反應。因此，nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）作為維生素 B3 的衍生物，被視為在 SARS-CoV-2 感染期間減少過度發炎並再生受損肺組織的潛在治療或支援劑，在此感染中過量的白血球浸潤造成廣泛的組織損傷。

source_document: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) is very unstable in the blood, which makes it difficult to measure and detect, and this instability is partially due to degradation of NR to nicotinamide (NAM), compromising its ability to reach peripheral tissues after oral administration. Despite this instability, the development of reliable methods for collection, processing, and measurement has enabled determination of the pharmacokinetic profile of orally administered NR, and the apparent oral bioavailability of a 1000 mg dose of NR is highly variable among individuals. The reduced form of NR, NRH, appears more stable than NR and does not undergo direct degradation in plasma.
context.zh-TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）在血液中非常不穩定，使其難以測量與偵測，且此不穩定性部分源於 NR 降解為 nicotinamide（NAM，菸鹼醯胺），損害了其口服給藥後到達周邊組織的能力。儘管此不穩定性，可靠收集、處理與測量方法的發展已使得口服 NR 的藥物動力學特徵得以確定，且 1000 mg 劑量 NR 的表觀口服生體可用率在人與人之間差異極大。NR 的還原型 NRH 似乎比 NR 更穩定，且不會在血漿中發生直接降解。

source_document: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: In response to nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation, a remarkable increase (45-fold) in nicotinic acid adenine dinucleotide (NAAD) was reported in a study with male human subjects and C57Bl6/J mice, indicating an additional conversion pathway of NR to NAD+. NAAD represents the most sensitive biomarker of effective NAD+ supplementation since it is undetectable in the blood prior to supplementation and its levels increase in the liver after orally administered NAD+ precursors. NR could also significantly elevate NAAD heart content, where the increase of NAD+ occurs in the absence of a steady-state NAD+ increase, and NR increased NAAD by at least 45-fold compared to baseline.
context.zh-TW: 在對 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）補充的反應中，一項針對男性人類受試者與 C57Bl6/J 小鼠的研究報導了 nicotinic acid adenine dinucleotide（NAAD，菸鹼酸腺嘌呤二核苷酸）的顯著增加（45 倍），顯示 NR 轉化為 NAD+ 的額外路徑。NAAD 代表了有效 NAD+ 補充最敏感的生物標記，因為它在補充前於血液中無法偵測，且其水平在口服 NAD+ 前驅物後於肝臟中上升。NR 亦能顯著提升心臟中的 NAAD 含量，其中 NAD+ 的增加發生於缺乏穩態 NAD+ 增加的情況下，且 NR 相較於基線將 NAAD 提升了至少 45 倍。

source_document: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

subject: NRH

context.en-US: NRH, the reduced form of nicotinamide riboside, is bioavailable in mice and increases NAD+ in both cultured cells (5-10-fold above the baseline) and in mice, in a more potent and faster manner than NR, and it is detectable in circulation after oral intake or intraperitoneal injection. A NMRK-independent pathway for the NRH-induced NAD+ increase has been demonstrated, consistent with the recent discovery of a novel biosynthetic route of NAD+ from NRH through the NMNH intermediate, where adenosine kinase (ADK) acts as an NRH kinase. The presence of endogenous NRH in the liver of mouse models was confirmed, establishing NRH as a valid natural precursor of NAD+.
context.zh-TW: NRH（nicotinamide riboside 的還原型）在小鼠中具有生物可用率，並以比 NR 更強效且更快速的方式提升培養細胞（高於基線 5-10 倍）與小鼠中的 NAD+，且在口服攝取或腹腔注射後可在循環中偵測到。NRH 誘發的 NAD+ 增加之 NMRK 非依賴性路徑已被證實，這與近期發現的從 NRH 經由 NMNH 中間產物生成 NAD+ 的新穎生物合成路徑一致，其中 adenosine kinase（ADK，腺苷激酶）作為 NRH 激酶。小鼠模型肝臟中內源性 NRH 的存在已獲確認，確立了 NRH 作為 NAD+ 的有效天然前驅物。

source_document: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

subject: Adenosine Kinase

context.en-US: Adenosine kinase (ADK) acts as an NRH kinase in a recently discovered novel biosynthetic route of NAD+ from NRH (the reduced form of nicotinamide riboside) through the NMNH intermediate, providing a NMRK-independent pathway for the NRH-induced NAD+ increase. NRH is more stable than nicotinamide riboside (NR), which degrades to nicotinamide in the blood, and NRH increases NAD+ in both cultured cells (5-10-fold above the baseline) and mice, in a more potent and faster manner than NR. Endogenous NRH was detected in the liver of mouse models, establishing NRH as a valid natural precursor of NAD+.
context.zh-TW: adenosine kinase（ADK，腺苷激酶）在近期發現的從 NRH（nicotinamide riboside 的還原型）經由 NMNH 中間產物生成 NAD+ 的新穎生物合成路徑中作為 NRH 激酶，提供了 NRH 誘發 NAD+ 增加的 NMRK 非依賴性路徑。NRH 比 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）更穩定，後者在血液中降解為 nicotinamide，且 NRH 以比 NR 更強效且更快速的方式提升培養細胞（高於基線 5-10 倍）與小鼠中的 NAD+。小鼠模型肝臟中偵測到內源性 NRH，確立了 NRH 作為 NAD+ 的有效天然前驅物。

source_document: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) administration can elevate NAD+ levels in mammalian cells and tissues without activating GPR109A, the receptor that mediates nicotinic acid-induced flushing, which is why NR is not associated with the painful flushing side effect seen with niacin. Although nicotinic acid (NA) and nicotinamide (NAM) can enter the NAD+ salvage pathway, several preclinical studies have confirmed that both can cause painful flushing sensations at therapeutic doses or other toxic effects. NR, in contrast, was confirmed across a number of studies as well-tolerated up to 2 g of a daily dose, with no flushing or severe side effects reported.
context.zh-TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）給藥能提升哺乳動物細胞與組織中的 NAD+ 水平，而無須活化 GPR109A（介導 nicotinic acid 誘發潮紅的受體），這就是為何 NR 與 niacin（菸鹼酸）所見的疼痛性潮紅副作用無關。儘管 nicotinic acid（NA）與 nicotinamide（NAM）能進入 NAD+ 回收路徑，數項臨床前研究已確認兩者皆可在治療劑量下造成疼痛性潮紅感或其他毒性作用。相對地，NR 在眾多研究中被確認每日劑量高達 2 g 仍耐受良好，且無潮紅或嚴重副作用的報告。

source_document: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

subject: Nicotinic acid

context.en-US: Nicotinic acid (NA, niacin) is implicated with flushing at doses higher than 50 mg/day, and several preclinical studies have confirmed that both NA and nicotinamide (NAM) can cause painful flushing sensations at therapeutic doses or other toxic effects. NA shows lowering effects on blood lipid levels and is used to treat dyslipidemia, but this flushing side effect limits its tolerability. In contrast, nicotinamide riboside (NR) elevates NAD+ levels without activating GPR109A, the receptor that mediates nicotinic acid-induced flushing, and was confirmed across a number of studies as well-tolerated up to 2 g of a daily dose, with no flushing or severe side effects.
context.zh-TW: nicotinic acid（NA，niacin/菸鹼酸）在每日劑量高於 50 mg 時與潮紅相關，且數項臨床前研究已確認 NA 與 nicotinamide（NAM）皆可在治療劑量下造成疼痛性潮紅感或其他毒性作用。NA 展現降低血脂水平的效果並被用於治療血脂異常，但此潮紅副作用限制了其耐受性。相對地，nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）提升 NAD+ 水平而無須活化 GPR109A（介導 nicotinic acid 誘發潮紅的受體），並在眾多研究中被確認每日劑量高達 2 g 仍耐受良好，且無潮紅或嚴重副作用。

source_document: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Among the three precursors nicotinic acid (NA), nicotinamide (NAM), and nicotinamide riboside (NR), only NR could prolong survival and induce hematopoietic stem cell regeneration, as documented in a study with mice treated with irradiation. This implies advantages of the NR precursor for potential use in cancer patients undergoing chemo- or radiotherapy, and orally administered NR was also found to improve resistance to and reversal of chemotherapeutic neuropathy. NR's ability to rejuvenate stem cells appears to be a general phenomenon during treatment and has been suggested to underlie a small but significant extension of lifespan in mice.
context.zh-TW: 在三種前驅物 nicotinic acid（NA）、nicotinamide（NAM）與 nicotinamide riboside（NR）之中，唯有 NR 能延長存活並誘發造血幹細胞再生，此記載於一項以照射處理小鼠的研究中。這暗示了 NR 前驅物在癌症患者接受化療或放療時潛在使用的優勢，且口服 NR 亦被發現能改善對化療神經病變的抵抗力與其逆轉。NR 使幹細胞年輕化的能力似乎為治療期間的普遍現象，並被認為是小鼠中微小但顯著的壽命延長的基礎。

source_document: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

subject: Nicotinic acid

context.en-US: Nicotinic acid (NA, niacin) shows lowering effects on blood lipid levels, and it is used to treat dyslipidemia, although it is implicated with flushing at doses higher than 50 mg/day. In contrast, nicotinamide (NAM) does not affect lipid blood levels, yet it can exhibit sirtuin-inhibiting effects at higher doses, while nicotinamide riboside (NR) does not cause flushing because it does not activate GPR109A. The distinct physiological responses of the NAD+ precursors NA, NAM, and NR, despite all three raising NAD+ and NADP+ levels, are important for selecting the appropriate precursor for specific therapeutic indications.
context.zh-TW: nicotinic acid（NA，niacin/菸鹼酸）展現降低血脂水平的效果，並被用於治療血脂異常，儘管其在每日劑量高於 50 mg 時與潮紅相關。相對地，nicotinamide（NAM）不影響血脂水平，但其在較高劑量下可展現抑制 sirtuin 的效果，而 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）因不活化 GPR109A 而不會造成潮紅。NAD+ 前驅物 NA、NAM 與 NR 儘管三者皆提升 NAD+ 與 NADP+ 水平，其截然不同的生理反應對於選擇適當前驅物以用於特定治療適應症相當重要。

source_document: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

subject: Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease

context.en-US: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is widely considered a hepatic manifestation of metabolic syndrome as it is found to be associated with type 2 diabetes, obesity, and insulin resistance, and sirtuins are downregulated in NAFLD patients, a state characterized by liver steatosis. Raising NAD+ through nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation can restore sirtuin-driven fatty acid oxidation, inhibit lipogenesis, and reduce cholesterol levels, thereby improving liver health and reducing fat accumulation through induction of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response.
context.zh-TW: 非酒精性脂肪肝疾病（NAFLD）被廣泛視為代謝症候群的肝臟表現，因為它被發現與第二型糖尿病、肥胖與胰島素抗性相關，且 sirtuins 在 NAFLD 患者中被下調，此狀態以肝臟脂肪變性為特徵。透過 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）補充提升 NAD+ 能恢復 sirtuin 驅動的脂肪酸氧化、抑制脂肪生成並降低膽固醇水平，從而透過誘發粒線體未摺疊蛋白反應改善肝臟健康並減少脂肪堆積。

source_document: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

subject: NRH

context.en-US: Since nicotinamide riboside (NR) is unstable in blood circulation, partially due to degradation to nicotinamide, its ability to reach peripheral tissues after oral administration is compromised, and this limitation could be overcome by the administration of NRH, the reduced form of NR, which appears to be more stable than NR and does not undergo direct degradation in plasma. NRH is detectable in circulation after oral intake or intraperitoneal injection, and it increases NAD+ in both cultured cells (5-10-fold above the baseline) and mice, in a more potent and faster manner than NR, through a NMRK-independent pathway in which adenosine kinase acts as an NRH kinase.
context.zh-TW: 由於 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）在血液循環中不穩定，部分源於降解為 nicotinamide，其口服給藥後到達周邊組織的能力受損，而此限制可透過給予 NRH（NR 的還原型）來克服，後者似乎比 NR 更穩定且不會在血漿中發生直接降解。NRH 在口服攝取或腹腔注射後可在循環中偵測到，並透過以 adenosine kinase 作為 NRH 激酶的 NMRK 非依賴性路徑，以比 NR 更強效且更快速的方式提升培養細胞（高於基線 5-10 倍）與小鼠中的 NAD+。

source_document: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 promotes glucose-stimulated insulin secretion from pancreatic beta-cells, inhibits the effects of oxidative stress in type 2 diabetic mice, and protects against insulin resistance in peripheral tissues, and it is an NAD+-dependent deacetylase whose activity is increased by nicotinamide riboside (NR) administration. SIRT1 overexpression also promotes fatty acid oxidation and inhibits lipogenesis, protecting the liver from steatosis, and sirtuins are downregulated in patients with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 促進胰島 beta 細胞中葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌，抑制第二型糖尿病小鼠中氧化壓力的效應，並保護周邊組織免於胰島素抗性，且其為一種 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶，其活性因 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）給藥而增加。SIRT1 過表現亦促進脂肪酸氧化並抑制脂肪生成，保護肝臟免於脂肪變性，且 sirtuins 在非酒精性脂肪肝疾病患者中被下調。

source_document: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

subject: Nicotinamide Riboside

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) is the third discovered NAD+ precursor and naturally occurs in milk, and it is already available as a nutraceutical, with its chloride salt given GRAS (generally regarded as safe) status. NAD+ intermediates such as NR are found in a wide variety of foods, including meat, eggs, dairy, certain vegetables, and whole wheat, and high availability of NR has been observed in the normal human diet. Oral supplementation with NR has been shown to increase NAD+ levels in multiple tissues along with increased sirtuin activity, improved mitochondrial function, and regenerative potential of stem cells, making NR a leading candidate among NAD+ precursors.
context.zh-TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）是第三個被發現的 NAD+ 前驅物，天然存在於牛奶中，且已作為營養補充品可供使用，其氯化鹽被授予 GRAS（generally regarded as safe，一般認為安全）地位。諸如 NR 之類的 NAD+ 中間產物存在於多種食物中，包括肉類、蛋、乳製品、某些蔬菜與全麥，且在正常人類飲食中觀察到 NR 的高可用性。口服 NR 補充已被證實能提升多種組織中的 NAD+ 水平，同時伴隨 sirtuin 活性增加、粒線體功能改善與幹細胞的再生潛力，使 NR 成為 NAD+ 前驅物中的領先候選者。

source_document: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A (UA) is a naturally occurring compound classified within the urolithins, a family of gut-microbiota-derived metabolites that form when dietary polyphenols are processed in the gastrointestinal tract. The review describes urolithins as compounds present in pomegranates and certain other fruits and nuts such as strawberries, walnut kernels, and peanuts, with ellagitannins serving as their precursors. As a member of this family, Urolithin A has attracted considerable research attention due to its pharmacological effects, encompassing anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, anti-tumor, and anti-aging properties, and it is a primary focus of research into muscle health and performance.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A（UA）是一種天然存在的化合物，歸類於 urolithins（尿石素）家族，這是一類當膳食多酚在胃腸道中被處理時所形成的腸道菌叢衍生代謝物。該綜述將 urolithins 描述為存在於石榴與某些其他水果和堅果（如草莓、核桃仁與花生）中的化合物，以 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）作為其前驅物。作為此家族的一員，Urolithin A 因其藥理作用（涵蓋抗發炎、抗氧化、抗腫瘤與抗衰老特性）而吸引了相當多的研究關注，且它是肌肉健康與表現研究的主要焦點。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A is a natural metabolite derived from ellagitannins, polyphenolic precursors found in pomegranate, walnut, almond, strawberry, and blueberry. During digestion, microbial enzymes in the colon convert ellagitannins through stepwise enzymatic and metabolic reactions to yield urolithin A. Because ellagitannin intake is a precondition for urolithin A formation, dietary consumption of ellagitannin-rich foods supplies an abundance of precursor molecules for intestinal microbial metabolism, facilitating the generation of urolithin A and increasing its systemic availability.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 是一種源自 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）的天然代謝物，後者為存在於石榴、核桃、杏仁、草莓與藍莓中的多酚類前驅物。在消化期間，結腸中的微生物酵素透過逐步的酵素與代謝反應將 ellagitannins 轉化以產生 urolithin A。由於 ellagitannin 攝取是 urolithin A 形成的先決條件，飲食攝取富含 ellagitannin 的食物提供了豐富的前驅物分子供腸道微生物代謝，促進 urolithin A 的生成並增加其全身性可用性。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Gut Microbiome

context.en-US: The production of urolithin A depends largely on the metabolic activities of the gut microbiota. During digestion, polyphenolic compounds such as tannins and anthocyanins undergo enzymatic reactions and metabolic conversions facilitated by microbial enzymes, culminating in the production of urolithin A. This metabolism predominantly takes place in the colon, which houses a variety of microbial groups including Proteobacteria, Clostridium, Bifidobacterium, Eubacterium, and Enterococcus faecium that possess distinct metabolic functions, so individual differences in intestinal microbial composition influence how much urolithin A a person produces and absorbs.
context.zh-TW: urolithin A 的生成主要取決於腸道菌叢的代謝活動。在消化期間，多酚類化合物（如 tannins（單寧）與 anthocyanins（花青素））經歷由微生物酵素促進的酵素反應與代謝轉化，最終產生 urolithin A。此代謝主要發生於結腸，其中棲息著多種微生物群體，包括 Proteobacteria、Clostridium、Bifidobacterium、Eubacterium 與 Enterococcus faecium，它們具有獨特的代謝功能，因此腸道微生物組成的個體差異會影響一個人生成與吸收的 urolithin A 量。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Pomegranate

context.en-US: Pomegranate is cited as one of the primary and richest dietary sources of urolithin A. Pomegranate peel and seeds contain abundant polyphenolic compounds, including ellagitannins that are metabolized by the gut microbiota into urolithin A. Consequently, consuming pomegranate supplies an abundance of precursor molecules for intestinal microbial metabolism, facilitating the generation of urolithin A, and pomegranate consumption is a standard dietary route to increase systemic urolithin A exposure alongside other sources such as walnut, almond, strawberry, and blueberry.
context.zh-TW: 石榴被引述為 urolithin A 的主要且最豐富的膳食來源之一。石榴皮與籽含有豐富的多酚類化合物，包括被腸道菌叢代謝為 urolithin A 的 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）。因此，食用石榴提供了豐富的前驅物分子供腸道微生物代謝，促進 urolithin A 的生成，且食用石榴是增加全身性 urolithin A 暴露的標準膳食途徑，與核桃、杏仁、草莓與藍莓等其他來源並列。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Liver

context.en-US: Once absorbed into the circulation, urolithin A undergoes further metabolism through multiple metabolic pathways, with the liver playing a central role. Metabolic enzymes present in the liver convert urolithin A into its mercaptan and sulfate forms. Hepatic enzyme inducers such as rifampicin and carbamazepine can increase the activity of these metabolic enzymes, accelerating urolithin A metabolism and reducing its half-life in the body, whereas enzyme inhibitors such as clarithromycin slow its metabolism and clearance and can lead to accumulation of urolithin A.
context.zh-TW: 一旦吸收進入循環系統，urolithin A 會經由多條代謝途徑進一步代謝，其中肝臟扮演核心角色。肝臟中的代謝酶將 urolithin A 轉化為其硫醇（mercaptan）與硫酸鹽（sulfate）形式。肝臟酶誘導劑如 rifampicin 與 carbamazepine 可提升這些代謝酶的活性，加速 urolithin A 的代謝並縮短其在體內的半衰期；而酶抑制劑如 clarithromycin 則減緩其代謝與清除，可能導致 urolithin A 蓄積。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Kidney

context.en-US: Urolithin A and its metabolites can be excreted from the body through the kidneys and intestines. Renal function can influence the rate of urolithin A elimination, since a portion of the compound and its conjugated forms is cleared in the urine, while additional urolithin A is further metabolized into other compounds within the intestines before being eliminated through feces. Renal function, intestinal permeability, and individual characteristics are therefore among the physiological factors that shape the bioavailability, metabolism, and distribution of urolithin A.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 及其代謝物可經由腎臟與腸道排出體外。腎功能會影響 urolithin A 的排除速率，因為部分化合物及其結合形式經尿液清除，而另有部分 urolithin A 在腸道內進一步代謝為其他化合物後再經糞便排出。因此，腎功能、腸道通透性與個體特徵，是形塑 urolithin A 生體可用率、代謝與分布的生理因素之一。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Rifampicin

context.en-US: Rifampicin is a hepatic enzyme inducer that can increase the activity of certain metabolic enzymes in the liver, potentially accelerating the metabolism of urolithin A and reducing its half-life in the body. This illustrates the broader principle that drugs interacting with cytochrome P450 enzymes in the liver can competitively inhibit or induce these enzymes, thereby disrupting the metabolism and clearance of urolithin A and altering its systemic exposure. Common antibiotics, antifungal drugs, and anticancer drugs have been reported to interact with CYP450 enzymes in this way.
context.zh-TW: Rifampicin 是一種肝臟酶誘導劑，可提升肝臟中某些代謝酶的活性，可能加速 urolithin A 的代謝並縮短其在體內的半衰期。這說明了更廣泛的原則：與肝臟中 cytochrome P450 酶交互作用的藥物，可競爭性抑制或誘導這些酶，從而干擾 urolithin A 的代謝與清除，並改變其全身暴露量。常見的抗生素、抗真菌藥物與抗癌藥物皆曾被報導以這種方式與 CYP450 酶交互作用。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A activates the PINK1/Parkin signaling pathway involved in mitochondrial quality control. Activation of this pathway promotes selective aggregation, degradation, and removal of damaged mitochondria, and PINK1 is one of the principal regulatory proteins mediating mitophagy. By engaging PINK1-dependent signaling, urolithin A enhances the clearance of dysfunctional mitochondria, an effect central to its characterization as a mitophagy activator and to its reported benefits for mitochondrial health, muscle function, and prevention of cellular degeneration.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 活化參與粒線體品質控制的 PINK1/Parkin 訊息傳遞路徑。此路徑的活化促進受損粒線體的選擇性聚集、降解與移除，而 PINK1 是介導粒線體自噬（mitophagy）的主要調控蛋白之一。透過啟動依賴 PINK1 的訊號，urolithin A 增強失能粒線體的清除，此效應是其被歸類為粒線體自噬活化劑的核心，也是其被報導對粒線體健康、肌肉功能與預防細胞退化有益的原因。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: PINK1

context.en-US: Mitochondrial autophagy, also known as mitophagy, refers to the selective degradation of mitochondria through the autophagic process, and its regulation is mediated by proteins such as PINK1 and Parkin. PINK1 is a key sensor of mitochondrial damage that recruits Parkin to trigger degradation of dysfunctional organelles, maintaining mitochondrial turnover and homeostasis. Urolithin A activates this PINK1/Parkin signaling pathway to promote the selective aggregation, degradation, and removal of damaged mitochondria, thereby supporting mitochondrial quality control and cellular health.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體自噬（mitochondrial autophagy），亦稱 mitophagy，是指透過自噬過程對粒線體進行選擇性降解，其調控由 PINK1 與 Parkin 等蛋白介導。PINK1 是粒線體損傷的關鍵感測器，會招募 Parkin 以觸發失能胞器的降解，維持粒線體更新與恆定。Urolithin A 活化此 PINK1/Parkin 訊息傳遞路徑，促進受損粒線體的選擇性聚集、降解與移除，從而支持粒線體品質控制與細胞健康。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A activates mitochondrial autophagy (mitophagy), the selective degradation of damaged or defective mitochondria that maintains mitochondrial turnover and homeostasis. It promotes this process by activating the PINK1/Parkin signaling pathway and by upregulating glutathione S-transferases via the NRF2-ARE signaling pathway, thereby enhancing cellular autophagy and mitochondrial quality control. This mitophagy-activating activity is central to urolithin A's reported effects on mitochondrial health, muscle energy metabolism, and the prevention of dysfunctional mitochondrial accumulation that could otherwise lead to cellular degeneration.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 活化粒線體自噬（mitophagy），即對受損或缺陷粒線體進行選擇性降解，以維持粒線體更新與恆定。它透過活化 PINK1/Parkin 訊息傳遞路徑，以及經由 NRF2-ARE 訊息傳遞路徑上調 glutathione S-transferases，來促進此過程，從而增強細胞自噬與粒線體品質控制。此粒線體自噬活化活性，是 urolithin A 被報導對粒線體健康、肌肉能量代謝，以及預防失能粒線體堆積（否則可能導致細胞退化）產生效益的核心。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A stimulates the NRF2-Antioxidant Response Element (ARE) signaling pathway, which upregulates the expression of antioxidant and detoxifying enzymes such as glutathione S-transferases (GSTs). Through this Nrf2 antioxidant pathway, urolithin A enhances cellular antioxidant defense, supports cellular autophagy and mitochondrial quality control, and reduces oxidative stress. NRF2 activation is a recurring mechanism underlying urolithin A's antioxidant and cytoprotective actions across multiple cell types, including its reported ability to protect muscle cells during strenuous exercise.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 刺激 NRF2-Antioxidant Response Element (ARE) 訊息傳遞路徑，進而上調抗氧化與解毒酶（如 glutathione S-transferases (GSTs)）的表現。透過此 Nrf2 抗氧化路徑，urolithin A 增強細胞抗氧化防禦、支持細胞自噬與粒線體品質控制，並降低氧化壓力。NRF2 活化是 urolithin A 在多種細胞類型中抗氧化與細胞保護作用的反覆出現機制，包括其被報導能在劇烈運動時保護肌肉細胞的能力。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: NRF2

context.en-US: NRF2, acting through the Antioxidant Response Element, upregulates the expression of glutathione S-transferases (GSTs), which are pivotal detoxifying enzymes intricately related to antioxidant capacity. This transcriptional program, stimulated in the setting of urolithin A treatment, enhances cellular autophagy and mitochondrial quality control. GSTs are therefore downstream effectors of NRF2 signaling that help protect cells against oxidative and electrophilic stress and that support the removal and turnover of damaged mitochondria.
context.zh-TW: NRF2 透過 Antioxidant Response Element 作用，上調 glutathione S-transferases (GSTs) 的表現，而 GSTs 是與抗氧化能力密切相關的關鍵解毒酶。此轉錄程序在 urolithin A 處理下被刺激，進而增強細胞自噬與粒線體品質控制。因此，GSTs 是 NRF2 訊號的下游效應分子，協助保護細胞對抗氧化與親電子壓力，並支持受損粒線體的移除與更新。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A possesses the ability to directly scavenge free radicals by capturing and neutralizing reactive oxygen species such as peroxy radicals and superoxide radicals, thereby reducing cellular oxidative stress. This direct radical-scavenging activity, together with its ability to activate the Nrf2 antioxidant pathway and upregulate antioxidant enzymes such as glutathione peroxidase and superoxide dismutase, underpins urolithin A's classification as an antioxidant compound. During exercise, when the body generates excessive ROS that can damage cellular structures, this scavenging protects muscle cells and supports muscle health.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 具有直接清除自由基的能力，透過捕捉並中和過氧化自由基（peroxy radicals）與超氧自由基（superoxide radicals）等活性氧物種（reactive oxygen species），從而降低細胞氧化壓力。此直接的自由基清除活性，加上其活化 Nrf2 抗氧化路徑並上調如 glutathione peroxidase 與 superoxide dismutase 等抗氧化酶的能力，構成 urolithin A 被歸類為抗氧化化合物的基礎。在運動期間，當身體產生過量 ROS 而可能損害細胞結構時，此清除作用保護肌肉細胞並支持肌肉健康。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A reduces cellular oxidative stress through multiple mechanisms: it directly scavenges reactive oxygen species such as peroxy and superoxide radicals, activates the Nrf2 antioxidant pathway to upregulate enzymes like glutathione peroxidase and superoxide dismutase, and inhibits enzyme activities involved in ROS generation. During exercise, especially strenuous activities, the body is more susceptible to generating excessive ROS, and urolithin A lowers the level of oxidative stress within muscle cells, protecting cellular structures and functions and thereby promoting muscle health.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 透過多種機制降低細胞氧化壓力：它直接清除如過氧化與超氧自由基等活性氧物種，活化 Nrf2 抗氧化路徑以上調如 glutathione peroxidase 與 superoxide dismutase 等酶，並抑制參與 ROS 生成的酶活性。在運動期間，尤其是劇烈活動時，身體更容易產生過量 ROS，而 urolithin A 降低肌肉細胞內的氧化壓力水平，保護細胞結構與功能，從而促進肌肉健康。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A can regulate the cell cycle by inhibiting the activity of cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs) and reducing the expression of cell cycle proteins such as cyclin D1, leading to cell cycle arrest in the G1 phase. It also increases the levels of cell cycle inhibitory proteins such as p21 and p27. This cell-cycle control, achieved through modulation of CDK activity and cyclin expression, contributes to urolithin A's reported antiproliferative activity and to its effects on cell cycle-related protein kinase complexes.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 可透過抑制 cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs) 的活性並降低如 cyclin D1 等細胞週期蛋白的表現，來調節細胞週期，導致 G1 期細胞週期停滯。它亦提升如 p21 與 p27 等細胞週期抑制蛋白的水平。此透過調控 CDK 活性與 cyclin 表現而達成的細胞週期控制，有助於 urolithin A 被報導的抗增殖活性，以及其對細胞週期相關蛋白激酶複合體的效應。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A can regulate the cell cycle by increasing the levels of cell cycle inhibitory proteins such as p21 and p27, complementing its inhibition of cyclin-dependent kinase activity and its reduction of cyclin D1 expression. Elevation of these cell cycle inhibitory proteins promotes cell cycle arrest in the G1 phase. Together these effects define urolithin A's capacity to modulate cell cycle progression, a property with relevance to its anti-tumor and antiproliferative activity in cancer contexts.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 可透過提升如 p21 與 p27 等細胞週期抑制蛋白的水平來調節細胞週期，補足其對 cyclin-dependent kinase 活性的抑制以及對 cyclin D1 表現的降低。這些細胞週期抑制蛋白的升高促進 G1 期細胞週期停滯。這些效應共同界定了 urolithin A 調節細胞週期進程的能力，此特性與其在癌症情境中的抗腫瘤與抗增殖活性相關。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A can induce cell death through multiple pathways. Studies have found that urolithin A increases the Bax/Bcl-2 ratio, resulting in the loss of mitochondrial membrane potential, release of cytochrome c, and activation of the caspase cascade, ultimately leading to cell apoptosis. It also activates the JNK (c-Jun N-terminal kinase) and p38 MAPK (mitogen-activated protein kinase) signaling pathways, further promoting apoptosis. These pro-apoptotic effects underpin urolithin A's anti-tumor activity and its ability to regulate cell death in various contexts.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 可透過多條路徑誘導細胞死亡。研究發現 urolithin A 提升 Bax/Bcl-2 比值，導致粒線體膜電位喪失、cytochrome c 釋出，以及 caspase 級聯反應活化，最終導致細胞凋亡。它亦活化 JNK (c-Jun N-terminal kinase) 與 p38 MAPK (mitogen-activated protein kinase) 訊息傳遞路徑，進一步促進凋亡。這些促凋亡效應是 urolithin A 抗腫瘤活性及其在各種情境中調節細胞死亡能力的基礎。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A induces apoptosis by increasing the Bax/Bcl-2 ratio, which results in the loss of mitochondrial membrane potential, release of cytochrome c, and activation of the cascade of caspases, ultimately leading to cell apoptosis. Modulation of the pro-apoptotic to anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family ratio is a classical intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptosis trigger. It represents one of the several mechanisms through which urolithin A promotes programmed cell death, in addition to its activation of JNK and p38 MAPK signaling.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 透過提升 Bax/Bcl-2 比值誘導凋亡，此比值升高導致粒線體膜電位喪失、cytochrome c 釋出，以及 caspase 級聯反應活化，最終導致細胞凋亡。調節促凋亡與抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族比值，是經典的內在（粒線體）凋亡觸發因子。這代表了 urolithin A 促進程序性細胞死亡的數種機制之一，此外還包括其對 JNK 與 p38 MAPK 訊號的活化。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Cytochrome c

context.en-US: Upon loss of mitochondrial membrane potential induced by an increased Bax/Bcl-2 ratio, cytochrome c is released from mitochondria and activates the cascade of caspases, ultimately leading to cell apoptosis. This mitochondrial intrinsic pathway of apoptosis is engaged by urolithin A as part of its pro-apoptotic actions. Cytochrome c release and subsequent activation of executioner caspases are central to intrinsic cell death signaling downstream of mitochondrial permeabilization and contribute to the anti-tumor activity reported for urolithin A.
context.zh-TW: 在 Bax/Bcl-2 比值升高所誘發的粒線體膜電位喪失後，cytochrome c 從粒線體釋出並活化 caspase 級聯反應，最終導致細胞凋亡。此粒線體內在凋亡路徑被 urolithin A 作為其促凋亡作用的一部分所啟動。Cytochrome c 釋出與隨後執行型 caspases 的活化，是粒線體通透化下游內在細胞死亡訊號的核心，並有助於 urolithin A 被報導的抗腫瘤活性。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A activates the AMPK (adenosine monophosphate-activated protein kinase) signaling pathway, a pivotal regulator of energy metabolism. The literature demonstrates that urolithin A activates AMPK through a cascade involving the activation of SIRT3 and, subsequently, LKB1. AMPK activation promotes fatty acid oxidation and insulin sensitivity while reducing fatty acid synthesis and gluconeogenesis, and it can increase mitochondrial biogenesis and glycogen synthesis, ultimately improving muscle energy supply and metabolism and enhancing muscle performance.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 活化 AMPK (adenosine monophosphate-activated protein kinase) 訊息傳遞路徑，這是能量代謝的關鍵調節者。文獻顯示 urolithin A 透過涉及 SIRT3 活化、隨後 LKB1 活化的級聯反應來活化 AMPK。AMPK 活化促進脂肪酸氧化與胰島素敏感性，同時降低脂肪酸合成與糖質新生，並可增加粒線體生成與肝醣合成，最終改善肌肉能量供應與代謝，並提升肌肉表現。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: AMPK

context.en-US: Activation of AMPK promotes fatty acid oxidation and insulin sensitivity while reducing fatty acid synthesis and gluconeogenesis, and it can also increase mitochondrial biogenesis and glycogen synthesis. Through AMPK-dependent signaling, urolithin A improves muscle energy supply and metabolism. AMPK is therefore a central node connecting cellular energy status to muscle metabolic adaptation, endurance, and overall muscle performance, and its activation is a key mechanism underlying the metabolic effects attributed to urolithin A.
context.zh-TW: AMPK 的活化促進脂肪酸氧化與胰島素敏感性，同時降低脂肪酸合成與糖質新生，並可增加粒線體生成與肝醣合成。透過依賴 AMPK 的訊號，urolithin A 改善肌肉能量供應與代謝。因此，AMPK 是連結細胞能量狀態與肌肉代謝適應、耐力及整體肌肉表現的中央節點，而其活化是歸因於 urolithin A 的代謝效應的關鍵機制。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A modulates the activity of peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ), a crucial transcription factor involved in adipocyte differentiation, glucose metabolism, and cholesterol metabolism. Studies indicate that urolithin A can increase the expression of PPARγ and the transcription of its downstream target genes, thereby promoting fatty acid oxidation, improving insulin sensitivity, and reducing cholesterol synthesis and absorption. These metabolic regulatory effects position PPARγ signaling as a mediator of urolithin A's influence on energy metabolism.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 調節 peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ) 的活性，這是參與脂肪細胞分化、葡萄糖代謝與膽固醇代謝的重要轉錄因子。研究指出 urolithin A 可提升 PPARγ 的表現及其下游標的基因轉錄，從而促進脂肪酸氧化、改善胰島素敏感性，並降低膽固醇合成與吸收。這些代謝調節效應使 PPARγ 訊號成為 urolithin A 影響能量代謝的中介者。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: PPARγ

context.en-US: PPARγ is a transcription factor involved in adipocyte differentiation, glucose metabolism, and cholesterol metabolism, among other processes. Urolithin A increases PPARγ expression and the transcription of its downstream target genes, thereby promoting fatty acid oxidation, improving insulin sensitivity, and reducing cholesterol synthesis and absorption. PPARγ signaling thus contributes to the metabolic regulatory effects attributed to urolithin A, complementing its activation of the AMPK pathway in supporting muscle energy metabolism.
context.zh-TW: PPARγ 是參與脂肪細胞分化、葡萄糖代謝與膽固醇代謝等過程的轉錄因子。Urolithin A 提升 PPARγ 表現及其下游標的基因轉錄，從而促進脂肪酸氧化、改善胰島素敏感性，並降低膽固醇合成與吸收。因此，PPARγ 訊號有助於歸因於 urolithin A 的代謝調節效應，補足其對 AMPK 路徑的活化以支援肌肉能量代謝。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: The literature demonstrates that urolithin A activates AMPK through a cascade involving the activation of SIRT3 and, subsequently, LKB1. In this cascade, the mitochondrial deacetylase SIRT3 promotes the activation of LKB1, which in turn activates AMPK. This SIRT3-LKB1-AMPK axis links urolithin A treatment to enhanced mitochondrial biogenesis, fatty acid oxidation, and improved muscle energy metabolism and performance, and it illustrates how mitochondrial deacetylase activity connects to cellular energy-sensing signaling.
context.zh-TW: 文獻顯示 urolithin A 透過涉及 SIRT3 活化、隨後 LKB1 活化的級聯反應來活化 AMPK。在此級聯中，粒線體去乙醯酶 SIRT3 促進 LKB1 的活化，而 LKB1 隨之活化 AMPK。此 SIRT3-LKB1-AMPK 軸將 urolithin A 處理與增強的粒線體生成、脂肪酸氧化，以及改善的肌肉能量代謝與表現連結起來，並說明了粒線體去乙醯酶活性如何連結至細胞能量感測訊號。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: LKB1

context.en-US: Urolithin A activates AMPK through a cascade involving the activation of SIRT3 and subsequently LKB1, with LKB1 acting as the upstream kinase that directly activates AMPK. LKB1 is a master upstream kinase for the AMPK family, and its activation links mitochondrial deacetylase activity to cellular energy sensing. AMPK activation in turn promotes fatty acid oxidation, mitochondrial biogenesis, and improved muscle energy supply and metabolism, supporting the ergogenic and metabolic effects reported for urolithin A.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 透過涉及 SIRT3 活化、隨後 LKB1 活化的級聯反應來活化 AMPK，其中 LKB1 作為直接活化 AMPK 的上游激酶。LKB1 是 AMPK 家族的主要上游激酶，其活化將粒線體去乙醯酶活性連結至細胞能量感測。AMPK 活化隨之促進脂肪酸氧化、粒線體生成，以及改善的肌肉能量供應與代謝，支持 urolithin A 被報導的增能與代謝效應。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: AMPK

context.en-US: By activating AMPK, urolithin A can increase mitochondrial biogenesis and enhance fatty acid oxidation and glycogen synthesis, ultimately improving muscle energy supply and metabolism and enhancing muscle performance. AMPK-driven mitochondrial biogenesis is a major mechanism through which energy-sensing interventions expand the mitochondrial network to meet cellular energy demands. It is a key downstream consequence of urolithin A treatment and is closely coupled to the activation of PGC-1α, the master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis.
context.zh-TW: 透過活化 AMPK，urolithin A 可增加粒線體生成並增強脂肪酸氧化與肝醣合成，最終改善肌肉能量供應與代謝並提升肌肉表現。由 AMPK 驅動的粒線體生成，是能量感測介入藉以擴展粒線體網絡以滿足細胞能量需求的主要機制。它是 urolithin A 處理的關鍵下游結果，並與粒線體生成的主要調節者 PGC-1α 的活化緊密耦合。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A enhances the expression and activation of PGC-1α, a pivotal transcriptional coactivator that regulates mitochondrial biogenesis, the formation of respiratory chain complexes, and processes such as mitochondrial fission and fusion. The scientific literature provides evidence that urolithin A activates PGC-1α through a cascade that includes the activation of SIRT3, followed by LKB1 and AMPK. This enhancement is crucial for ensuring an adequate muscle energy supply and supporting endurance performance by improving mitochondrial function and quantity.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 增強 PGC-1α 的表現與活化，PGC-1α 是調節粒線體生成、呼吸鏈複合體形成，以及粒線體分裂與融合等過程的關鍵轉錄共活化因子。科學文獻提供證據顯示 urolithin A 透過包含 SIRT3 活化、隨後 LKB1 與 AMPK 的級聯反應來活化 PGC-1α。此增強作用對於透過改善粒線體功能與數量，以確保充足的肌肉能量供應並支持耐力表現至關重要。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: PGC-1α

context.en-US: PGC-1α is an important transcription coactivator that regulates mitochondrial biogenesis and cellular energy metabolism, including the formation of respiratory chain complexes and processes such as mitochondrial fission and fusion. Research has found that urolithin A enhances the expression and activation of PGC-1α, improving mitochondrial function and increasing mitochondrial quantity, which is crucial for ensuring an adequate muscle energy supply and supporting endurance performance. PGC-1α activation is therefore a central mechanism of urolithin A's effects on mitochondrial health.
context.zh-TW: PGC-1α 是調節粒線體生成與細胞能量代謝的重要轉錄共活化因子，包括呼吸鏈複合體的形成以及粒線體分裂與融合等過程。研究發現 urolithin A 增強 PGC-1α 的表現與活化，改善粒線體功能並增加粒線體數量，這對確保充足的肌肉能量供應並支持耐力表現至關重要。因此，PGC-1α 活化是 urolithin A 對粒線體健康效應的核心機制。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A regulates protein synthesis and growth of muscle cells by inhibiting specific regulatory factors within the mTOR signaling pathway, such as PI3K (phosphoinositide 3-kinase) and AKT (protein kinase B). The literature demonstrates that urolithin A inhibits mTOR by first inhibiting PI3K and then AKT. Downregulation of PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling underlies several of urolithin A's reported anti-inflammatory, metabolic, and pro-autophagic effects, and it supports muscle growth while maintaining muscle quality.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 透過抑制 mTOR 訊息傳遞路徑中的特定調節因子（如 PI3K (phosphoinositide 3-kinase) 與 AKT (protein kinase B)）來調節肌肉細胞的蛋白質合成與生長。文獻顯示 urolithin A 先抑制 PI3K 再抑制 AKT，從而抑制 mTOR。PI3K-AKT-mTOR 訊號的下調，是 urolithin A 被報導的數項抗發炎、代謝與促自噬效應的基礎，並在維持肌肉品質的同時支持肌肉生長。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A regulates protein synthesis and growth of muscle cells by inhibiting specific regulatory factors within the mTOR (mammalian target of rapamycin) signaling pathway, such as PI3K and AKT. The literature demonstrates that urolithin A inhibits mTOR by first inhibiting PI3K and then AKT. This regulation supports muscle growth and maintains muscle quality while also contributing to autophagy induction and anti-inflammatory phenotypes, positioning mTOR inhibition as a key signaling mechanism of urolithin A.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 透過抑制 mTOR (mammalian target of rapamycin) 訊息傳遞路徑中的特定調節因子（如 PI3K 與 AKT）來調節肌肉細胞的蛋白質合成與生長。文獻顯示 urolithin A 先抑制 PI3K 再抑制 AKT，從而抑制 mTOR。此調節在支持肌肉生長並維持肌肉品質的同時，亦有助於自噬誘導與抗發炎表型，使 mTOR 抑制成為 urolithin A 的關鍵訊號機制。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: mTOR

context.en-US: The mTOR (mammalian target of rapamycin) pathway plays a key role in regulating muscle protein synthesis and cell growth. Research has found that urolithin A can regulate protein synthesis and growth of muscle cells by inhibiting specific regulatory factors within the mTOR signaling pathway, such as PI3K and AKT. Balanced mTOR signaling supports muscle growth and maintains muscle quality, while urolithin A's inhibitory effects on this pathway favor autophagy induction and anti-inflammatory responses in addition to metabolic regulation.
context.zh-TW: mTOR (mammalian target of rapamycin) 路徑在調節肌肉蛋白質合成與細胞生長中扮演關鍵角色。研究發現 urolithin A 可透過抑制 mTOR 訊息傳遞路徑中的特定調節因子（如 PI3K 與 AKT）來調節肌肉細胞的蛋白質合成與生長。平衡的 mTOR 訊號支持肌肉生長並維持肌肉品質，而 urolithin A 對此路徑的抑制作用，除代謝調節外，亦有利於自噬誘導與抗發炎反應。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: The NF-κB (nuclear factor kappa-light-chain-enhancer of activated B cells) pathway is implicated in the regulation of inflammatory responses, and urolithin A has been found to inhibit its activation, reducing the production of inflammatory mediators. The literature indicates that urolithin A blocks the NF-κB/STAT1 axis through the inactivation of TLR3/TRIF signaling. By inhibiting the NF-κB pathway, urolithin A can mitigate muscle damage and pain caused by inflammatory responses, thereby promoting muscle recovery and health.
context.zh-TW: NF-κB (nuclear factor kappa-light-chain-enhancer of activated B cells) 路徑參與發炎反應的調節，且已發現 urolithin A 可抑制其活化，減少發炎介質的產生。文獻指出 urolithin A 透過使 TLR3/TRIF 訊號失活來阻斷 NF-κB/STAT1 軸。透過抑制 NF-κB 路徑，urolithin A 可減輕由發炎反應引起的肌肉損傷與疼痛，從而促進肌肉恢復與健康。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: The literature indicates that urolithin A blocks the NF-κB/STAT1 axis through the inactivation of TLR3/TRIF signaling, reducing inflammation and enhancing antioxidant defense. TLR3/TRIF is an upstream innate immune signaling route whose inactivation dampens downstream NF-κB activation and the production of inflammatory mediators. This mechanism contributes to urolithin A's anti-inflammatory activity in settings such as poly(I:C)-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages and supports its role in muscle recovery and protection from inflammation-induced damage.
context.zh-TW: 文獻指出 urolithin A 透過使 TLR3/TRIF 訊號失活來阻斷 NF-κB/STAT1 軸，從而減少發炎並增強抗氧化防禦。TLR3/TRIF 是一條上游先天免疫訊號路線，其失活會抑制下游 NF-κB 活化與發炎介質的產生。此機制有助於 urolithin A 在如 poly(I:C) 刺激的 RAW264.7 巨噬細胞等情境中的抗發炎活性，並支持其在肌肉恢復與免受發炎誘發損傷中的角色。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: The FoxO (forkhead box O) family is a group of transcription factors involved in regulating the synthesis and degradation of muscle proteins. Studies have found that urolithin A can inhibit the degradation of muscle proteins by suppressing the activation of FoxO, primarily by inhibiting the nuclear activity of FoxO and reducing its regulation of specific protein degradation pathways. This suppression of FoxO signaling preserves muscle mass under catabolic conditions and complements urolithin A's anabolic effects on protein synthesis.
context.zh-TW: FoxO (forkhead box O) 家族是一群參與調節肌肉蛋白合成與降解的轉錄因子。研究發現 urolithin A 可透過抑制 FoxO 的活化來抑制肌肉蛋白的降解，主要是透過抑制 FoxO 的核活性並降低其對特定蛋白降解路徑的調節。此對 FoxO 訊號的抑制在分解代謝條件下保留肌肉量，並補足 urolithin A 對蛋白質合成的合成代謝效應。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: FOXO

context.en-US: The FoxO (forkhead box O) family is a group of transcription factors involved in regulating the synthesis and degradation of muscle proteins. Under catabolic conditions, nuclear FoxO drives expression of atrophy-related genes and activates specific protein degradation pathways that break down muscle proteins. Urolithin A suppresses FoxO activation, primarily by inhibiting its nuclear activity and reducing its regulation of these degradation pathways, thereby attenuating muscle protein degradation and helping to preserve muscle mass.
context.zh-TW: FoxO (forkhead box O) 家族是一群參與調節肌肉蛋白合成與降解的轉錄因子。在分解代謝條件下，核內 FoxO 驅動萎縮相關基因的表現，並活化分解肌肉蛋白的特定蛋白降解路徑。Urolithin A 抑制 FoxO 活化，主要是透過抑制其核活性並降低其對這些降解路徑的調節，從而減緩肌肉蛋白降解並有助於保留肌肉量。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: The ubiquitin-proteasome system stands as one of the main pathways responsible for the degradation of intracellular proteins, including muscle proteins. Studies have found that urolithin A can attenuate the degradation of muscle proteins by inhibiting the activity of the ubiquitin-proteasome system, possibly by influencing the activity of specific ubiquitin ligases or proteasomes. This inhibition contributes to urolithin A's muscle-sparing and anti-atrophic effects, helping to preserve muscle mass during catabolic states.
context.zh-TW: 泛素-蛋白酶體系統（ubiquitin-proteasome system）是負責細胞內蛋白（包括肌肉蛋白）降解的主要路徑之一。研究發現 urolithin A 可透過抑制泛素-蛋白酶體系統的活性來減緩肌肉蛋白的降解，可能是透過影響特定泛素連接酶或蛋白酶體的活性。此抑制作用有助於 urolithin A 的肌肉保留與抗萎縮效應，在分解代謝狀態下幫助保留肌肉量。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Atrogin-1 and MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1 and 2) are pivotal molecules involved in muscle protein synthesis and degradation, functioning as muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligases that drive protein breakdown during atrophy. Studies have shown that urolithin A can regulate muscle protein synthesis and degradation by inhibiting the activity of mTORC1 and the expression of Atrogin-1/MuRF1, thereby reducing atrophy signaling, attenuating protein degradation, and preserving muscle mass.
context.zh-TW: Atrogin-1 與 MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1 and 2) 是參與肌肉蛋白合成與降解的關鍵分子，作為肌肉特異性 E3 泛素連接酶，在萎縮期間驅動蛋白分解。研究顯示 urolithin A 可透過抑制 mTORC1 的活性與 Atrogin-1/MuRF1 的表現，來調節肌肉蛋白合成與降解，從而降低萎縮訊號、減緩蛋白降解，並保留肌肉量。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1) is a muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligase that, together with Atrogin-1, marks muscle proteins for ubiquitin-proteasome degradation during atrophy. Studies have shown that urolithin A can regulate muscle protein synthesis and degradation by inhibiting the activity of mTORC1 and the expression of Atrogin-1/MuRF1, thereby reducing muscle protein degradation and supporting the maintenance of muscle mass under catabolic conditions. Suppressing this E3 ligase reduces ubiquitination of muscle proteins and complements urolithin A's anabolic effects on protein synthesis.
context.zh-TW: MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1) 是一種肌肉特異性 E3 泛素連接酶，與 Atrogin-1 共同在萎縮期間標記肌肉蛋白以供泛素-蛋白酶體降解。研究顯示 urolithin A 可透過抑制 mTORC1 的活性與 Atrogin-1/MuRF1 的表現，來調節肌肉蛋白合成與降解，從而減少肌肉蛋白降解，並在分解代謝條件下支持肌肉量的維持。抑制此 E3 連接酶可減少肌肉蛋白的泛素化，並補足 urolithin A 對蛋白質合成的合成代謝效應。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Accumulating evidence suggests that urolithin A may promote muscle protein synthesis and muscle growth through various pathways. It can increase the rate of protein synthesis within muscle cells while inhibiting protein degradation processes, allowing muscle cells to more effectively synthesize new proteins and maintain muscle mass. This anabolic action, combined with enhanced mitochondrial function and energy metabolism, supports muscle hypertrophy, the maintenance of muscle mass, and improved recovery after exercise.
context.zh-TW: 累積證據顯示 urolithin A 可能透過多種路徑促進肌肉蛋白合成與肌肉生長。它可提升肌肉細胞內蛋白質合成速率，同時抑制蛋白降解過程，使肌肉細胞能更有效地合成新蛋白並維持肌肉量。此合成代謝作用，結合增強的粒線體功能與能量代謝，支持肌肉肥大、肌肉量的維持，以及運動後更佳的恢復。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A may have a positive impact on muscle hypertrophy and maintenance of muscle mass through multiple pathways, including promotion of muscle cell repair and growth, enhancement of mitochondrial function and energy metabolism, and regulation of protein synthesis and degradation processes. It can increase the cross-sectional area of muscle fibers, muscle protein content, and muscle strength, thus promoting muscle hypertrophy. Current research is still limited and mostly conducted in vitro or in animal experiments, so human studies are needed.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 可能透過多種路徑對肌肉肥大與肌肉量維持產生正面影響，包括促進肌肉細胞修復與生長、增強粒線體功能與能量代謝，以及調節蛋白質合成與降解過程。它可增加肌纖維橫截面積、肌肉蛋白含量與肌肉力量，從而促進肌肉肥大。目前研究仍有限且多為體外或動物實驗，因此需要人體研究。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: In pathological conditions characterized by muscle atrophy, such as certain neuromuscular diseases or extended periods of immobility, urolithin A may offer potential benefits. It can stimulate muscle protein synthesis while inhibiting protein degradation pathways, including FoxO signaling, the ubiquitin-proteasome system, and the expression of Atrogin-1/MuRF1, helping to preserve muscle mass and mitigate muscle wasting. Human clinical validation of these anti-atrophic effects remains limited, but the mechanistic evidence is supportive.
context.zh-TW: 在以肌肉萎縮為特徵的病理狀態下，如某些神經肌肉疾病或長期不活動，urolithin A 可能提供潛在益處。它可刺激肌肉蛋白合成，同時抑制蛋白降解路徑，包括 FoxO 訊號、泛素-蛋白酶體系統，以及 Atrogin-1/MuRF1 的表現，有助於保留肌肉量並減輕肌肉消耗。這些抗萎縮效應的人體臨床驗證仍有限，但機制證據具支持性。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A plays a substantial role in promoting mitochondrial function and muscle energy metabolism. It enhances mitochondrial activity by activating gene expression similar to PGC-1α, regulates the quantity and quality of mitochondria, and protects mitochondria from oxidative stress-induced damage by clearing free radicals. By promoting the formation and enhanced function of mitochondrial respiratory chain complexes, it improves the synthesis rate of ATP in muscle cells, supporting muscle performance, recovery, and endurance.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 在促進粒線體功能與肌肉能量代謝中扮演重要角色。它透過活化類似 PGC-1α 的基因表現來增強粒線體活性，調節粒線體的數量與品質，並透過清除自由基保護粒線體免於氧化壓力誘發的損傷。透過促進粒線體呼吸鏈複合體的形成與功能增強，它改善肌肉細胞中 ATP 的合成速率，支持肌肉表現、恢復與耐力。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Urolithin A can promote the formation and enhanced function of mitochondrial respiratory chain complexes, thereby improving the synthesis rate of ATP in muscle cells. ATP is the primary energy molecule for muscle cells and is crucial for muscle contraction and exercise performance. By promoting mitochondrial function and muscle energy metabolism, urolithin A increases the energy supply to muscle cells, improving endurance, strength, and recovery, and providing sustained energy support during prolonged or high-intensity exercise.
context.zh-TW: Urolithin A 可促進粒線體呼吸鏈複合體的形成與功能增強，從而改善肌肉細胞中 ATP 的合成速率。ATP 是肌肉細胞的主要能量分子，對肌肉收縮與運動表現至關重要。透過促進粒線體功能與肌肉能量代謝，urolithin A 增加對肌肉細胞的能量供應，改善耐力、力量與恢復，並在長時間或高強度運動期間提供持續的能量支持。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Urolithin A

context.en-US: Existing evidence suggests that urolithin A may have a positive role in improving endurance and delaying muscle fatigue, both of which are intricately linked to mitochondrial function. By enhancing mitochondrial activity and ATP synthesis, urolithin A provides sustained energy support during prolonged or high-intensity exercise, and its anti-inflammatory properties alleviate tissue damage and muscle soreness caused by inflammation. Most studies have been conducted in vitro or on animals, so more human studies are needed to validate these effects.
context.zh-TW: 現有證據顯示 urolithin A 可能在改善耐力與延遲肌肉疲勞方面具有正面作用，兩者皆與粒線體功能密切相關。透過增強粒線體活性與 ATP 合成，urolithin A 在長時間或高強度運動期間提供持續的能量支持，且其抗發炎特性可減輕由發炎引起的組織損傷與肌肉痠痛。大多數研究為體外或動物實驗，因此需要更多人體研究來驗證這些效應。

source_document: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md

subject: Persulfates

context.en-US: Persulfates are employed as the oxidizing agent to convert adrenaline (epinephrine) into adrenochrome. The use of persulfates is advantageous because it precludes the effluent disposal problems associated with potassium ferricyanide and is significantly cheaper, although persulfate oxidation alone is slow and requires catalysts such as water-soluble bismuth salts. Suitable persulfates include potassium persulfate, sodium persulfate, and ammonium persulfate, with the sodium and ammonium salts preferred for their good solubility in water.
context.zh-TW: 過硫酸鹽被用作氧化劑，將腎上腺素（epinephrine）轉化為腎上腺紅。使用過硫酸鹽的優點在於可避免與鐵氰化鉀相關的廢液處理問題，且成本顯著較低，儘管單獨的過硫酸鹽氧化反應緩慢，需要水溶性鉍鹽等催化劑。適用的過硫酸鹽包括過硫酸鉀、過硫酸鈉和過硫酸銨，其中鈉鹽和銨鹽因在水中溶解度良好而為優選。

source_document: _document_ - US4501923A - Process for preparing adrenochrome.md

subject: Bismuth

context.en-US: Water-soluble salts of bismuth, such as bismuth nitrate, bismuth oxynitrate, bismuth oxycarbonate, and bismuth citrate, accelerate the persulfate oxidation of adrenaline into adrenochrome, producing high-quality adrenochrome in high yields in a short period of time (about 30 to 45 minutes). Bismuth salts are used in amounts of 0.001 to 0.01 mole per mole of adrenaline; amounts below this do not significantly increase the reaction rate, while amounts above 0.01 mole may cause excessive oxidation and decompose the adrenochrome into tar-like by-products.
context.zh-TW: 水溶性鉍鹽，如硝酸鉍、鹼式硝酸鉍、鹼式碳酸鉍和檸檬酸鉍，可加速過硫酸鹽將腎上腺素氧化為腎上腺紅的反應，在短時間內（約30至45分鐘）以高產率生產高品質的腎上腺紅。鉍鹽的使用量為每莫耳腎上腺素0.001至0.01莫耳；低於此量不會顯著提高反應速率，而高於0.01莫耳則可能導致過度氧化並使腎上腺紅分解為焦油狀副產物。

source_document: _document_ - US4501923A - Process for preparing adrenochrome.md

subject: Adrenochrome

context.en-US: Adrenochrome is an intermediate for adrenochrome monosemicarbazone (carbazochrome), which is known as a hemostatic agent. In the patented process, semicarbazide reacts with the freshly produced adrenochrome to form carbazochrome, stabilizing the unstable quinoid intermediate and yielding a useful medicine. The carbazochrome obtained by the bismuth-catalyzed persulfate method is far less colored than that prepared using the potassium ferricyanide method, and its identity is confirmed by UV absorption at 354 nm and characteristic infrared absorptions.
context.zh-TW: 腎上腺紅是腎上腺紅單縮氨脲（carbazochrome）的中間體，後者為已知的止血劑。在該專利方法中，氨基硫脲與新鮮生成的腎上腺紅反應形成carbazochrome，穩定不穩定的醌式中間體並產生有用的藥物。經鉍催化過硫酸鹽法所得的carbazochrome，其色澤遠低於以鐵氰化鉀法製備者，其身份經354 nm的紫外線吸收及特徵紅外線吸收確認。

source_document: _document_ - US4501923A - Process for preparing adrenochrome.md

subject: Adrenochrome

context.en-US: Adrenochrome is an intermediate for adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine, a hemostatic agent formed when aminoguanidine reacts with the freshly generated adrenochrome. This hydrazone derivative both stabilizes the chemically unstable adrenochrome and serves as a useful medicine. Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine obtained by the bismuth-catalyzed persulfate process is far less colored than that prepared by the method using potassium ferricyanide, and its identity is confirmed by UV absorption maxima at 348 nm and 445 nm.
context.zh-TW: 腎上腺紅是腎上腺紅單胺基胍的中間體，後者為胺基胍與新鮮生成的腎上腺紅反應所形成的止血劑。此腙衍生物既能穩定化學上不穩定的腎上腺紅，又可用作有用的藥物。經鉍催化過硫酸鹽法所得的腎上腺紅單胺基胍，其色澤遠低於以鐵氰化鉀法製備者，其身份經348 nm和445 nm的紫外線吸收極大值確認。

source_document: _document_ - US4501923A - Process for preparing adrenochrome.md

subject: Carbazochrome

context.en-US: Carbazochrome (adrenochrome monosemicarbazone) is known as a hemostatic agent, one of two hydrazine derivatives of adrenochrome described in the patent, the other being adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine. These hydrazine derivatives serve both for the stabilization of adrenochrome and for the preparation of useful medicines that act to stop bleeding. In the patented process, semicarbazide is added to the adrenochrome solution at 0 to 15 degrees C at pH 5 to 7 to form carbazochrome, which is then isolated by filtration and purified.
context.zh-TW: Carbazochrome（腎上腺紅單縮氨脲）為已知的止血劑，是專利中描述的兩種腎上腺紅肼衍生物之一，另一種為腎上腺紅單胺基胍。這些肼衍生物既用於穩定腎上腺紅，也用於製備具有止血作用的實用藥物。在該專利方法中，於0至15°C、pH 5至7下將氨基硫脲加入腎上腺紅溶液中以形成carbazochrome，隨後經過濾分離並純化。

source_document: _document_ - US4501923A - Process for preparing adrenochrome.md

subject: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine

context.en-US: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine is a hemostatic agent formed by reacting aminoguanidine with adrenochrome, an unstable ortho-quinoid intermediate. Along with carbazochrome, it is one of the hydrazine derivatives of adrenochrome that serve as useful medicines with hemostatic activity. In the patented process, stabilization with aminoguanidine is carried out at pH 2 to 5, and the purified compound shows characteristic ultraviolet absorption maxima at 348 nm and 445 nm that confirm its identity. The product is isolated by filtration, washed and dried to a powder, and may be further purified by active carbon treatment and recrystallization.
context.zh-TW: 腎上腺紅單胺基胍是由胺基胍與腎上腺紅（一種不穩定的鄰醌式中間體）反應形成的止血劑。與carbazochrome一起，它是腎上腺紅的肼衍生物之一，可作為具有止血活性的實用藥物。在該專利方法中，以胺基胍進行穩定化的操作在pH 2至5下進行，純化後的化合物呈現348 nm和445 nm的特徵紫外線吸收極大值，確認其身份。產物經過濾分離、洗滌並乾燥成粉末，並可進一步經活性碳處理和重結晶純化。

source_document: _document_ - US4501923A - Process for preparing adrenochrome.md

subject: Potassium ferricyanide

context.en-US: Adrenochrome has been commercially prepared by oxidizing adrenaline or its salts with potassium ferricyanide in an aqueous medium. This process is uneconomical because of the large quantities of potassium ferricyanide needed, the ensuing effluent disposal problems, and variability in product quality. The patent presents a bismuth-catalyzed persulfate process as a superior alternative that precludes these problems and yields less-colored carbazochrome and adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine products.
context.zh-TW: 腎上腺紅的商業製備一直是於水相介質中以鐵氰化鉀氧化腎上腺素或其鹽類。此製程不具經濟效益，因為需要大量鐵氰化鉀、隨之產生廢液處理問題，且產品品質不穩定。該專利提出一種鉍催化過硫酸鹽製程作為更優的替代方案，可避免這些問題，並產生色澤較淺的carbazochrome和腎上腺紅單胺基胍產物。

source_document: _document_ - US4501923A - Process for preparing adrenochrome.md

subject: Hydrazines

context.en-US: Adrenochrome is very unstable due to its ortho-quinoid structure and is therefore usually stabilized by conventional derivatization with hydrazines, e.g., aminoguanidine, semicarbazide, phenylhydrazine, o-nitrophenylhydrazine, p-nitrophenylhydrazine, and 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine. These hydrazine derivatives serve both for the stabilization of adrenochrome and for the preparation of useful medicines such as hemostatics. The stabilization treatment is generally conducted for 30 minutes to 3 hours at a temperature of 0 to 15 degrees C.
context.zh-TW: 腎上腺紅因其鄰醌式結構而極不穩定，因此通常透過與肼類（如胺基胍、氨基硫脲、苯肼、鄰硝基苯肼、對硝基苯肼和2,4-二硝基苯肼）的常規衍生化來穩定。這些肼衍生物既用於穩定腎上腺紅，也用於製備如止血劑等實用藥物。穩定化處理通常在0至15°C下進行30分鐘至3小時。

source_document: _document_ - US4501923A - Process for preparing adrenochrome.md

subject: Aminoguanidine

context.en-US: Aminoguanidine reacts with adrenochrome to form adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine, a hemostatic agent. In the patented process, an aqueous aminoguanidine hydrochloride solution is added to the adrenochrome reaction mixture at below 5 degrees C, the pH is adjusted to about 2.9 for the stabilization step, and the product is precipitated at a final pH of 9.0 to 10.0 with sodium hydroxide. The reaction yields about 41.0 g of crude product that is purified by dissolving in sulfurous acid, active carbon treatment, and the addition of EDTA, and the purified compound shows ultraviolet absorption maxima at 348 nm and 445 nm.
context.zh-TW: 胺基胍與腎上腺紅反應形成腎上腺紅單胺基胍，一種止血劑。在該專利方法中，於低於5°C下將鹽酸胺基胍水溶液加入腎上腺紅反應混合物中，將pH調整至約2.9以進行穩定化步驟，並以氫氧化鈉在最終pH 9.0至10.0下沉澱產物。反應產生約41.0 g粗產物，經溶於亞硫酸、活性碳處理及添加EDTA純化，純化後的化合物呈現348 nm和445 nm的紫外線吸收極大值。

source_document: _document_ - US4501923A - Process for preparing adrenochrome.md

subject: Semicarbazide

context.en-US: Semicarbazide reacts with adrenochrome to form adrenochrome monosemicarbazone (carbazochrome), a hemostatic agent. In the patented process, semicarbazide hydrochloride is added to the adrenochrome solution at below 10 degrees C in the presence of a potassium acetate buffer, with the stabilization carried out at pH 5 to 7. The reaction yields about 40.0 g of crude powder that is purified by dissolving in dilute sodium hydroxide, active carbon treatment, and precipitation at pH 5.5, and the purified product shows an ultraviolet absorption maximum at 354 nm and characteristic infrared absorptions matching those of an authentic sample.
context.zh-TW: 氨基硫脲與腎上腺紅反應形成腎上腺紅單縮氨脲（carbazochrome），一種止血劑。在該專利方法中，於低於10°C下、在醋酸鉀緩衝液存在下將鹽酸氨基硫脲加入腎上腺紅溶液中，穩定化在pH 5至7下進行。反應產生約40.0 g粗粉末，經溶於稀氫氧化鈉、活性碳處理及在pH 5.5下沉澱純化，純化後的產物呈現354 nm的紫外線吸收極大值，以及與標準品相符的特徵紅外線吸收。

source_document: _document_ - US4501923A - Process for preparing adrenochrome.md

subject: Sodium hydrogencarbonate

context.en-US: The aqueous reaction medium for adrenochrome synthesis is maintained at a pH from 4 to 8, preferably with a buffer such as sodium hydrogencarbonate, sodium dihydrogenphosphate, disodium hydrogenphosphate, potassium acetate, or sodium acetate, with sodium hydrogencarbonate being preferred. The buffer is generally used in an amount of 4 to 7 moles, preferably 5 to 6 moles, per mole of adrenaline. Maintaining this pH range supports the persulfate oxidation of adrenaline catalyzed by water-soluble bismuth salts.
context.zh-TW: 腎上腺紅合成的水相反應介質維持在pH 4至8，較佳地使用如碳酸氫鈉、磷酸二氫鈉、磷酸氫二鈉、醋酸鉀或醋酸鈉等緩衝液，其中以碳酸氫鈉為優選。緩衝液通常以每莫耳腎上腺素4至7莫耳、較佳5至6莫耳的量使用。維持此pH範圍有助於水溶性鉍鹽催化的腎上腺素過硫酸鹽氧化。

source_document: _document_ - US4501923A - Process for preparing adrenochrome.md

subject: Adrenochrome

context.en-US: Adrenochrome is very unstable due to its ortho-quinoid (o-quinone) structure, and is therefore usually stabilized by conventional derivatization with hydrazines such as aminoguanidine and semicarbazide to form hemostatic medicines. This instability also means that during the persulfate oxidation of adrenaline, the produced adrenochrome may be further oxidized and decompose to black by-products, so the reaction is monitored by sampling and measuring the absorbance at 495 nm, which is stopped at the point of maximum yield.
context.zh-TW: 腎上腺紅因其鄰醌式（o-quinone）結構而極不穩定，因此通常透過與胺基胍和氨基硫脲等肼類的常規衍生化來穩定，以形成止血藥物。此不穩定性也意味著在腎上腺素的過硫酸鹽氧化過程中，生成的腎上腺紅可能進一步氧化並分解為黑色副產物，因此反應透過取樣並測量495 nm的吸光度來監控，並在產率最大時停止。

source_document: _document_ - US4501923A - Process for preparing adrenochrome.md

subject: Ammonium Persulfate

context.en-US: Ammonium persulfate is one of the suitable persulfate oxidizing agents for converting adrenaline into adrenochrome, together with potassium persulfate and sodium persulfate. Sodium and ammonium persulfates are preferred over potassium persulfate for their good solubility in water. In the examples, ammonium persulfate (about 0.42 mole) is used with a sodium hydrogencarbonate buffer and a bismuth salt catalyst at 0 to 5 degrees C to produce adrenochrome in maximum yield within about 30 to 45 minutes.
context.zh-TW: 過硫酸銨是將腎上腺素轉化為腎上腺紅的適用過硫酸鹽氧化劑之一，與過硫酸鉀和過硫酸鈉並用。過硫酸鈉和過硫酸銨因在水中溶解度良好而優於過硫酸鉀。在實施例中，過硫酸銨（約0.42莫耳）與碳酸氫鈉緩衝液及鉍鹽催化劑在0至5°C下使用，於約30至45分鐘內以最大產率生產腎上腺紅。

source_document: _document_ - US4501923A - Process for preparing adrenochrome.md

subject: Adrenochrome

context.en-US: During the oxidation of adrenaline, the reaction mixture is tinged with purplish red due to the production of adrenochrome, and its color becomes deeper with increasing adrenochrome content. The reaction is continued until the absorbance at a wavelength of 495 nm, measured by sampling the reaction mixture at an appropriate time, reaches a maximum, at which point further oxidation of the product is minimized and adrenochrome is obtained in maximum yield. The reaction time required for maximum yield varies from 30 to 45 minutes depending on the temperature of the reaction mixture and the level of catalyst employed.
context.zh-TW: 在腎上腺素氧化過程中，反應混合物因腎上腺紅的生成而呈紫紅色，且隨腎上腺紅含量增加而顏色加深。反應持續進行，直到於適當時間取樣反應混合物所測得的495 nm波長吸光度達到最大值，此時產物的進一步氧化降至最低，並以最大產率獲得腎上腺紅。達到最大產率所需的反應時間為30至45分鐘不等，取決於反應混合物的溫度和所用催化劑的量。
